jobs.description:
Located within CSLB’s GSPV department, the Director, Global Safety Lead, Formulation Safety provide expertise on all aspects of –clinical safety throughout the entire lifecycle of a product with special emphasis on ongoing evaluation of safety information during clinical development and post approval. (S)He will apply sound medical judgment for analysis and interpretation of complex clinical safety data for signal detection and initiation of safety risk management activities including safety specification, PV planning and risk minimization/mitigation. Integrate safety risk management activities of the product into their medical, business, and regulatory context.

The role serves as the safety representative in the cross-functional development teams and post-marketing product teams. It is responsible for setting safety strategy for these global projects. Strong product knowledge is needed for success in the role.

The role ensures that the medical and process standards delivered in CSLB are in alignment with the following safety objectives expected of manufacturers by internal and external stakeholders including regulators, governmental agencies, payors, physicians, patients and the general public:

• Complying with legal requirements and company standards of the PV (Pharmacovigilance) tasks and responsibilities.

• Preventing harm from adverse reactions in humans arising from the use of authorized medicinal products within or outside the terms of the market authorization or from occupational exposure.

• Promoting the safe and effective use of medicinal products in particular through providing timely information about the safety of medicinal products to patients, healthcare professionals and the public.

• Contributing to the protection of patients and public health.

Responsibilities and Accountabilities

• Safety Surveillance and Risk Management: Oversees safety management teams ensuring a thorough and consistent approach to the review of safety data emerging from clinical trials and from the post-marketing environment. Oversees the safety signal detection and medical signal evaluation process. Oversees analysis of aggregate safety data and the production of key company documents such as DSURs (Development Safety Update Reports), PSURs (Periodic Safety Update Reports) and risk management plans relating to the safety of medicinal products, which are subject to regulatory review and discussion.

• Quality Management: Ensures timely production of aggregate reports and answers to queries from Health Authorities according to consistent quality standards.

• Regulatory Agency Requests: Responsible for timely and concise responses to Regulatory Agency requests relating to patient safety.

• Inspections: Ensures regulatory agency inspection findings and internal audit findings relating to products of responsibility are addressed and resultant Corrective Action Plans (CAPA plans) are implemented efficiently and effectively in the function.

• Clinical Safety Development of the CSLB portfolio: Oversees all processes that lead to the production of safety sections and content of relevant clinical trial documents including protocols, investigator brochures, informed consent forms, clinical study reports. Oversees development of core safety information for new products. Sets the strategy, reviews and approves key filing documents including Integrated Summary of Safety (ISS), Summary of Clinical safety (SCS), and risk management plans (RMPs). Provides major contributions to current and potential safety issues, being proactive in addressing safety issues and setting up any additional systems to mitigate risk in CSLB’s studies. Gives guidance on various medical, product-related and process-related matters in a complex medical and scientific environment including many interface departments and functions.

• Clinical Safety Representation: Chairs the Safety Management Team (SMT). Represents GSPV in relevant cross functional teams.

Qualificati

descriptionByLocale.it:
Situato all'interno del dipartimento CSLB.s SPGV, il Direttore, Global Safety Lead, Formulation Safety fornisce consulenza su tutti gli aspetti della sicurezza clinica durante l'intero ciclo di vita di un prodotto con particolare attenzione alla valutazione in corso delle informazioni sulla sicurezza durante lo sviluppo clinico e post-approvazione. (S)Applicherà una sana valutazione medica per l'analisi e l'interpretazione di dati clinici complessi di sicurezza per l'individuazione dei segnali e l'avvio di attività di gestione del rischio di sicurezza, tra cui specifiche di sicurezza, pianificazione del fotovoltaico e riqualificazione/contenzioso del rischio.

• integrare le attività di gestione dei rischi in materia di sicurezza del prodotto nel contesto medico, commerciale e normativo.

Il ruolo di rappresentante della sicurezza nei team di sviluppo interfunzionali e nei team di prodotti post-marketing è quello di definire una strategia di sicurezza per questi progetti globali. Per il successo del ruolo è necessaria una forte conoscenza dei prodotti.

Il ruolo assicura che gli standard medici e di processo forniti in CSLB siano in linea con i seguenti obiettivi di sicurezza attesi dai produttori da parte di soggetti interni ed esterni, tra cui regolatori, agenzie governative, finanziatori, medici, pazienti e il pubblico in generale:

• Rispetto dei requisiti legali e degli standard aziendali dei compiti e delle responsabilità del fotovoltaico (farmacovigilanza).

• Prevenzione dei danni da reazioni avverse nell'uomo derivanti dall'uso di medicinali autorizzati all'interno o all'esterno dei termini dell'autorizzazione al mercato o dall'esposizione professionale.

• Promuovere l'uso sicuro ed efficace dei medicinali, in particolare fornendo ai pazienti, agli operatori sanitari e al pubblico informazioni tempestive sulla sicurezza dei medicinali.

• Contribuire alla protezione dei pazienti e della salute pubblica.

Responsabilità e responsabilità

• Sicurezza Sorveglianza e Gestione del Rischio: Supervisiona i team di gestione della sicurezza garantendo un approccio accurato e coerente alla revisione dei dati di sicurezza emersi dagli studi clinici e dall'ambiente post-marketing. Supervisiona il processo di rilevamento dei segnali di sicurezza e valutazione dei segnali medici. Supervisiona l'analisi dei dati aggregati di sicurezza e la produzione di documenti aziendali chiave quali DSUR (Development Safety Update Reports), PSUR (Periodic Safety Update Reports) e piani di gestione dei rischi relativi alla sicurezza dei medicinali, che sono oggetto di revisione e discussione normative.

• Gestione della Qualità: garantisce la tempestiva produzione di report aggregati e risposte alle domande delle Autorità Sanitarie secondo standard qualitativi coerenti.

• Richieste di Agenzia di regolamentazione: Responsabile per risposte tempestive e concise alle richieste di Agenzia di regolamentazione relative alla sicurezza dei pazienti.

• Ispezioni: garantisce che i risultati delle ispezioni delle agenzie di regolamentazione e i risultati delle verifiche interne relativi ai prodotti di responsabilità siano affrontati e che i piani d'azione correttivi (Piani d'azione del PACA) siano attuati in modo efficiente ed efficace nella funzione.

• Sviluppo della sicurezza clinica del portafoglio CSLB: Supervisiona tutti i processi che portano alla produzione di sezioni di sicurezza e il contenuto dei documenti relativi agli studi clinici, inclusi protocolli, brochure di ricerca, moduli di consenso informato, rapporti di studio clinico. Supervisiona lo sviluppo delle informazioni fondamentali sulla sicurezza per i nuovi prodotti. Imposta la strategia, esamina e approva documenti di deposito chiave tra cui il Riassunto Integrato della Sicurezza (ISS), il Riassunto della Sicurezza Clinica (SCS) e i piani di gestione dei rischi (RMP).

Fornisce importanti contributi alle questioni attuali e potenziali in materia di sicurezza, essendo proattivo nell'affrontare le questioni di sicurezza e nell'istituire sistemi aggiuntivi per attenuare i rischi negli studi della CSNB. Fornisce orientamenti su varie questioni mediche, relative ai prodotti e relative ai processi in un ambiente medico e scientifico complesso, tra cui molti dipartimenti e funzioni di interfaccia.

• Rappresentazione della sicurezza clinica: presiede il team di gestione della sicurezza (SMT). Rappresenta l'SPGV in squadre trasversali pertinenti.

D.P.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Die Abteilung GSPV, Director Global Safety Lead, Formulation Safety, bietet im Rahmen der CSLB, der GSPV, Expertise zu allen Aspekten der – klinischen Sicherheit während des gesamten Lebenszyklus eines Produkts mit besonderem Schwerpunkt auf der laufenden Bewertung von Sicherheitsinformationen während der klinischen Entwicklung und nach der Zulassung. (S)Er wird eine solide medizinische Beurteilung für die Analyse und Interpretation komplexer klinischer Sicherheitsdaten für die Signalerkennung und die Einleitung von Sicherheitsrisikomanagement-Aktivitäten einschließlich Sicherheitsspezifikation, PV-Planung und Risikominimierung/-mitigierung vornehmen.

Integrieren Sie die Sicherheitsrisikomanagement-Aktivitäten des Produkts in ihren medizinischen, geschäftlichen und regulatorischen Kontext.

Die Rolle dient als Sicherheitsbeauftragter in den funktionsübergreifenden Entwicklungsteams und Post-Marketing-Produktteams. Sie ist verantwortlich für die Festlegung von Sicherheitsstrategien für diese globalen Projekte. Starkes Produktwissen ist für den Erfolg in der Rolle notwendig.

Die Rolle gewährleistet, dass die in der CSLB erbrachten medizinischen und verfahrenstechnischen Standards mit den folgenden Sicherheitszielen übereinstimmen, die von den Herstellern von internen und externen Akteuren wie Regulierungsbehörden, Behörden, Zahlern, Ärzten, Patienten und der Öffentlichkeit erwartet werden:

• Erfüllung der gesetzlichen Anforderungen und der Unternehmensstandards der PV- (Pharmacovigilance) Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten.

• Vermeidung von Schäden durch Nebenwirkungen beim Menschen, die durch die Verwendung von zugelassenen Arzneimitteln innerhalb oder außerhalb der Bedingungen der Marktzulassung oder durch berufliche Exposition entstehen.

• Förderung der sicheren und wirksamen Anwendung von Arzneimitteln, insbesondere durch rechtzeitige Information der Patienten, Angehörigen der Gesundheitsberufe und der Öffentlichkeit über die Sicherheit von Arzneimitteln.

• Beitrag zum Schutz der Patienten und der öffentlichen Gesundheit.

Zuständigkeiten und Rechenschaftspflichten

• Sicherheitsüberwachung und Risikomanagement: Überwacht Sicherheitsmanagement-Teams, die einen gründlichen und konsistenten Ansatz für die Überprüfung von Sicherheitsdaten aus klinischen Studien und aus der Post-Marketing-Umgebung gewährleisten. Überwacht die Sicherheitssignalerkennung und die medizinische Signalbewertung. Überwacht die Analyse von aggregierten Sicherheitsdaten und die Erstellung von Schlüsseldokumenten des Unternehmens wie DSURs (Development Safety Update Reports), PSURs (Periodic Safety Update Reports) und Risikomanagementpläne im Zusammenhang mit der Sicherheit von Arzneimitteln, die Gegenstand einer regulatorischen Überprüfung und Diskussion sind.

• Qualitätsmanagement: Gewährleistung der rechtzeitigen Erstellung von aggregierten Berichten und Antworten auf Anfragen von Gesundheitsbehörden nach einheitlichen Qualitätsstandards.

• Anfragen der Regulierungsagentur: Verantwortlich für die rechtzeitige und präzise Beantwortung von Anfragen der Regulierungsagentur im Zusammenhang mit der Patientensicherheit.

• Inspektionen: Gewährleistung der Einhaltung der Inspektionsergebnisse der Regulierungsbehörde und der internen Auditergebnisse in Bezug auf die Produkte der Verantwortung und der damit verbundenen Korrektur-Aktionspläne (CAPA-Pläne) in der Funktion effizient und effektiv.

• Klinische Sicherheitsentwicklung des CSLB-Portfolios: Überwacht alle Prozesse, die zur Herstellung von Sicherheitsabschnitten und zum Inhalt relevanter klinischer Prüfdokumente führen, einschließlich Protokollen, Prüferbroschüren, informierten Zustimmungsformularen, klinischen Studienberichten. Überwacht die Entwicklung von grundlegenden Sicherheitsinformationen für neue Produkte. Legt die Strategie fest, überprüft und genehmigt Schlüsseldokumente einschließlich Integrierter Zusammenfassung der Sicherheit (ISS), Zusammenfassung der klinischen Sicherheit (SCS) und Risikomanagementpläne (RMPs).

Er leistet wichtige Beiträge zu aktuellen und potenziellen Sicherheitsfragen, ist proaktiv bei der Lösung von Sicherheitsproblemen und der Einrichtung zusätzlicher Systeme zur Risikominderung in Studien der CSLB. Er gibt Orientierung zu verschiedenen medizinischen, produktbezogenen und prozessbezogenen Fragen in einem komplexen medizinischen und wissenschaftlichen Umfeld, einschließlich vieler Schnittstellenabteilungen und Funktionen.

• Klinische Sicherheitsvertretung: Vorsitzende des Safety Management Teams (SMT). Er vertritt die GSPV in relevanten crossfunktionalen Teams.

Qualifikate
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Situé au sein de la CSLB, le département du VSSP, le directeur, Sécurité mondiale plomb, Sécurité de la formulation, fournissent une expertise sur tous les aspects de la sécurité clinique tout au long du cycle de vie d'un produit, en mettant l'accent sur l'évaluation continue de l'information sur l'innocuité pendant le développement clinique et après l'approbation. (S)Il appliquera un jugement médical solide pour l'analyse et l'interprétation de données complexes sur l'innocuité clinique pour la détection des signaux et le lancement d'activités de gestion des risques de sécurité, y compris les spécifications de sécurité, la planification du VP et la minimisation/atténuation des risques.

Intégrer les activités de gestion des risques liés à la sécurité du produit dans leur contexte médical, commercial et réglementaire.

Le rôle est de représenter la sécurité dans les équipes de développement interfonctionnelles et les équipes de produits post-commercialisation. Il est responsable de l'établissement de la stratégie de sécurité pour ces projets mondiaux.

Le rôle consiste à s'assurer que les normes médicales et de processus fournies par la DGSCS sont conformes aux objectifs de sécurité suivants que les fabricants attendent des intervenants internes et externes, y compris les organismes de réglementation, les organismes gouvernementaux, les payeurs, les médecins, les patients et le grand public :

• Se conformer aux exigences légales et aux normes de l'entreprise en matière de tâches et de responsabilités de la PV (Pharmacovigilance).

• Prévenir les effets nocifs des effets indésirables sur l'homme résultant de l'utilisation de médicaments autorisés dans les conditions de l'autorisation de mise sur le marché ou en dehors de celle-ci ou de l'exposition professionnelle.

• Promouvoir l'utilisation sûre et efficace des médicaments, notamment en fournissant des informations en temps opportun sur la sécurité des médicaments aux patients, aux professionnels de la santé et au public.

• Contribuer à la protection des patients et de la santé publique.

Responsabilités et responsabilités

• Surveillance de l'innocuité et gestion des risques : Supervise les équipes de gestion de l'innocuité en veillant à ce que les données de sécurité issues des essais cliniques et de l'environnement post-commercialisation soient examinées de façon approfondie et cohérente. Supervise la détection des signaux de sécurité et le processus d'évaluation des signaux médicaux.

• Gestion de la qualité : assure la production en temps voulu de rapports agrégés et de réponses aux demandes des autorités sanitaires selon des normes de qualité cohérentes.

• Demandes de l'Agence de réglementation : Responsable des réponses rapides et concises aux demandes de l'Agence de réglementation concernant la sécurité des patients.

• Inspections : S'assurer que les constatations des organismes de réglementation en matière d'inspection et les constatations des audits internes concernant les produits relevant de la responsabilité sont prises en compte et que les plans d'action corrective (plans de l'ACP) qui en résultent sont mis en œuvre de façon efficace et efficiente dans la fonction.

• Développement de la sécurité clinique du portefeuille de la DGSCS : supervise tous les processus qui mènent à la production de sections de sécurité et le contenu des documents d'essais cliniques pertinents, y compris les protocoles, les brochures des chercheurs, les formulaires de consentement éclairé, les rapports d'études cliniques. supervise l'élaboration de l'information de base sur la sécurité des nouveaux produits.

Apporte une contribution importante aux questions actuelles et potentielles de sécurité, en étant proactif dans le traitement des questions de sécurité et en mettant en place des systèmes supplémentaires pour atténuer les risques dans les études de la DGSLC.

• Représentation clinique en matière de sécurité : préside l'équipe de gestion de la sécurité (SMT) qui représente le VSS dans les équipes interfonctionnelles pertinentes.

Qualificati

jobs.description:
The Director Non-Clinical Due Diligence & External Evaluations provides scientific leadership for nonclinical due diligence supporting CSL’s in‑licensing, acquisitions, and strategic collaborations. The role ensures integrated, objective, and decision‑relevant evaluations of nonclinical pharmacology, PK/QSP, and toxicology data to identify development risks, data gaps, and mitigation strategies and to inform portfolio decisions.
The incumbent will further act as nonclinical representative for selected Research programs and support oversight of nonclinical strategies and programs across all Therapeutic Areas.

The role reports to the Executive Director, Head of Nonclinical Development.

Responsibilities and accountabilities

• Leads operational execution of nonclinical due diligence for assigned opportunities.

• Acts as hands‑on scientific integrator, translating expert input into clear risk narratives.

• Trusted subject‑matter lead for nonclinical DD on individual deals.

• Lead end-to-end nonclinical due diligence for individual assets or transactions, from request through final governance readout.

• Integrate input from Toxicology, PK/QSP, Nonclinical Pharmacology, and external experts into a single, coherent scientific assessment.

• Identify FIH‑enabling gaps, translational risks, and regulatory limitations, with clear mitigation proposals.

• Prepare high‑quality DD reports, executive summaries, and risk tables for governance review.

• Act as NCD scientific interface to Business Development and Therapeutic Area teams at the project level.

• Contribute to maintenance and continuous improvement of nonclinical DD frameworks and templates.

• Mentor junior contributors and matrix team members as appropriate.

• Escalates complex or high‑impact issues to Head of NCD

• Chair of “NCD Review Committee”

Qualifications:
Education:

• Advanced degree (Ph.D., D.V.M., or equivalent) in toxicology, pharmacology, or a related field

• Toxicology training, board certification preferred

Experience :

• Experience in nonclinical development (10+ years) with proven experience in due diligence or external innovation, ideally across various geographies.

• Strong understanding of FIH‑enabling nonclinical requirements, particularly for biologics and complex modalities.

• Ability to communicate complex scientific risk clearly to non‑expert stakeholders.

• Experience across multiple therapeutic areas and modalities is highly desirable.

Competencies:

• Proven ability to work effectively both independently or in a team setting, and to meet set goals by managing own timelines.

• Experience in working in cross-functional, multicultural and international teams.

• Excellent communication and analytical skills.

• Experience in analyzing and presenting research results to scientific and professional audiences.

• Strong planning and organizational skills.

• Ability to work successfully in a matrix organizational structure.

• Strong negotiation skills and ability to identify and engage internal and external expertise as needed.

• Good understanding of drug development process, strong knowledge of ICH/GLP

• Fluent in English, oral and written;

The role requires onsite presence 3 days per week.
The role can be based in Zurich, Switzerland or Waltham, USA.

About CSL Behring
CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives.

• Graduate/professional degree in law, public health, international relations, political sciences or similar disciplines preferred.

• Experience partnering with patient groups to advance shared policy goals

jobs.title: Executive Assistant
jobs.description:
Under the direction of senior leadership, the Executive Assistant provides comprehensive administrative and organizational support to assigned leadership within Research & Development. This role includes managing complex calendars, coordinating meetings and events, and handling domestic and international travel arrangements. The Executive Assistant ensures meeting readiness, manages individual expense reporting, and supports special projects as needed. The position requires interaction with a diverse group of internal stakeholders across all levels and locations, as well as external partners and visitors, while maintaining professionalism and confidentiality at all times.

Responsibilities

1. Administrative Support

• Provide diversified administrative support to assigned senior leaders and their teams, including word processing, filing, mailings, and document management.

• Organize and maintain confidential and time-sensitive materials and files.

Calendar & Meeting Management

• Manage calendars and schedule appointments for assigned executives and leadership team members.

• Ensure meeting materials are prepared and assist in tracking priorities and deliverables.

2. Event & Project Coordination

• Plan and manage special projects and events for assigned leadersa, including global meetings and project-related sessions.
• Arrange facilities, catering, invitations, and travel for internal and external participants.

• Monitor and control event budgets.

• Prepare visual presentations and meeting materials as needed.

3. Travel & Expense Coordination

• Coordinate domestic and international travel arrangements and compile itineraries.

• Prepare documents for travel-related meetings and process expense reports accurately and promptly.

• Reconcile corporate credit card accounts for assigned leaders

4. Budget & Compliance

• Monitor standard expenditures to ensure activities remain within established budgets.

• Manage implementation of legal contracts and agreements, ensuring proper signatures and maintaining organized files.

5. Onboarding & Collaboration

• Support onboarding of new hires of assigned leaders and collaborate with other administrative professionals to ensure a consistent experience.

• Serve as a liaison with internal and external stakeholders globally, representing the department professionally and maintaining confidentiality

6. Other Duties

• Perform other related duties as assigned.

Education Requirements
High School Diploma or equivalent vocational or technical training.
Bachelor’s degree or Technical College degree a plus.

Experience Requirements
3-5+ years' administrative support experience preferably in within pharmaceutical industry

This role requires working in at our site 3 days per week at our office location

descriptionByLocale.en:
Under the direction of senior leadership, the Executive Assistant provides comprehensive administrative and organizational support to assigned leadership within Research & Development. This role includes managing complex calendars, coordinating meetings and events, and handling domestic and international travel arrangements. The Executive Assistant ensures meeting readiness, manages individual expense reporting, and supports special projects as needed. The position requires interaction with a diverse group of internal stakeholders across all levels and locations, as well as external partners and visitors, while maintaining professionalism and confidentiality at all times.

Responsibilities

1. Administrative Support

• Provide diversified administrative support to assigned senior leaders and their teams, including word processing, filing, mailings, and document management.

• Organize and maintain confidential and time-sensitive materials and files.

Calendar & Meeting Management

• Manage calendars and schedule appointments for assigned executives and leadership team members.

• Ensure meeting materials are prepared and assist in tracking priorities and deliverables.

2. Event & Project Coordination

• Plan and manage special projects and events for assigned leadersa, including global meetings and project-related sessions.
• Arrange facilities, catering, invitations, and travel for internal and external participants.

• Monitor and control event budgets.

• Prepare visual presentations and meeting materials as needed.

3. Travel & Expense Coordination

• Coordinate domestic and international travel arrangements and compile itineraries.

• Prepare documents for travel-related meetings and process expense reports accurately and promptly.

• Reconcile corporate credit card accounts for assigned leaders

4. Budget & Compliance

• Monitor standard expenditures to ensure activities remain within established budgets.

• Manage implementation of legal contracts and agreements, ensuring proper signatures and maintaining organized files.

5. Onboarding & Collaboration

• Support onboarding of new hires of assigned leaders and collaborate with other administrative professionals to ensure a consistent experience.

• Serve as a liaison with internal and external stakeholders globally, representing the department professionally and maintaining confidentiality

6. Other Duties

• Perform other related duties as assigned.

Education Requirements
High School Diploma or equivalent vocational or technical training.
Bachelor’s degree or Technical College degree a plus.

Experience Requirements
3-5+ years' administrative support experience preferably in within pharmaceutical industry

This role requires working in at our site 3 days per week at our office location
#LI-Hybrid

About CSL Behring
CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives.

CSL Behring operates one of the world’s largest plasma collection networks, CSL Plasma. Our parent company, CSL, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs 32,000 people, and delivers its lifesaving therapies to people in more than 100 countries.

jobs.description:
Senior CI Specialist – Value Stream Bulk

Position Purpose
Are you passionate about driving operational excellence and transforming performance through Continuous Improvement?

As Senior CI Specialist , you will play a key role in shaping the future performance of Value Stream Bulk by advancing the CSL Operating System (COS) , driving a culture of continuous improvement, and enabling data-driven decision-making across the organization.

Partnering closely with leaders and cross-functional teams, you will identify improvement opportunities, lead impactful initiatives, and translate strategic objectives into tangible business results. From shopfloor execution to performance management and digital transformation, you will help strengthen compliance, quality, safety, delivery, efficiency, and operational reliability.

As a trusted Continuous Improvement expert, you will empower teams, challenge the status quo, and deliver sustainable improvements that enhance both business performance and patient supply. Through your leadership, coaching, and hands-on approach, you will contribute to building a high-performing organization focused on excellence, accountability, and continuous learning.

Reporting Relationships

Reports to: Senior Director, Head Value Stream Bulk
Key Interfaces: Manufacturing, QA, QC, Planning, Engineering, Training, Supply Chain, Operational Service, Global Operational Excellence
Functional Role: CI and COS Subject Matter Expert for Value Stream Bulk
Direct Reports: None (functional leadership and coaching responsibilities)

Key Responsibilities

Continuous Improvement & Operational Excellence

• Lead the deployment and continuous improvement of the CSL Operating System (COS) within Value Stream Bulk.

• Develop, manage, and execute the CI roadmap and portfolio, including project identification, business case development, prioritization, milestone planning, benefit tracking, and reporting.

• Identify and implement improvement opportunities to strengthen compliance, quality, efficiency, delivery performance, and process reliability.

• Lead and facilitate Kaizen events, Lean/Six Sigma initiatives, structured problem-solving workshops, and cross-functional improvement projects.

Performance Management & COS Reporting

• Drive KPI governance and performance management through COS-based reporting, dashboarding, visual management, and performance review routines.

• Conduct trend analyses and translate performance insights into prioritized improvement actions.

• Ensure transparency, standardization, and data integrity of performance reporting in alignment with CSL standards and business objectives.

• Monitor and communicate the impact of improvement initiatives through KPI improvement and benefit realization tracking.

Process Optimization & Change Leadership

• Drive process optimization, standardization, and digitalization initiatives across manufacturing and supporting functions.

• Coach leaders and employees in Lean Thinking, Operational Excellence principles, Visual Management, and structured problem solving.

• Act as a change agent to foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.

• Ensure successful implementation of improvement initiatives on time, within budget, and with sustainable results.

Qualifications Education

• Bachelor's degree or higher in Engineering, Natural Sciences, Business Administration, or a related discipline; equivalent experience in a GMP-regulated environment may be considered.

• Lean/Kaizen and Six Sigma certification preferred.

Experience

• Minimum 5 years of experience in Continuous Improvement, Operational Excellence, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, or Quality.

• Proven track record in leading cross-functional improvement initiatives and delivering measurable business results.

• Experience in GMP-regulated manufacturing environments.

Competencies

• Strong expertise in Lean, Six Sigma, performance management, and structured problem-so

In qualità di esperto di miglioramento continuo di fiducia, potrai abilitare i team, sfidare lo status quo, e fornire miglioramenti sostenibili che migliorano sia le prestazioni aziendali che l'offerta dei pazienti. Attraverso il vostro approccio di leadership, coaching e hands-on, contribuirete a costruire un'organizzazione altamente performante focalizzata sull'eccellenza, la responsabilità e l'apprendimento continuo. • Guidare la distribuzione e il miglioramento continuo del sistema operativo CSL (COS) all'interno di Value Stream Bulk.
• Sviluppare, gestire ed eseguire la roadmap e il portafoglio CI, tra cui l'identificazione del progetto, lo sviluppo di casi aziendali, la priorità, la pianificazione delle pietre miliari, il monitoraggio dei benefici e la segnalazione.
• Identificare e implementare opportunità di miglioramento per rafforzare la conformità, la qualità, l'efficienza, le prestazioni di consegna e l'affidabilità del processo.
• Guidare e facilitare eventi Kaizen, iniziative Lean/Six Sigma, workshop strutturati di problem solving e progetti di miglioramento interfunzionale. Gestione delle prestazioni & COS Reporting
• Guidare la governance KPI e la gestione delle prestazioni attraverso reportistica, dashboard, gestione visiva e routine di revisione delle prestazioni.
• Condurre analisi della tendenza e tradurre intuizioni delle prestazioni in azioni di miglioramento prioritarie.
• Assicurare la trasparenza, la standardizzazione e l'integrità dei dati del reporting delle prestazioni in conformità con gli standard CSL e gli obiettivi aziendali.
• Monitorare e comunicare l'impatto delle iniziative di miglioramento attraverso il miglioramento del KPI e il monitoraggio della realizzazione dei benefici. Ottimizzazione del processo & Cambia leadership
• Avviare le iniziative di ottimizzazione, standardizzazione e digitalizzazione del processo attraverso funzioni di produzione e supporto.
• I dirigenti degli allenatori e i dipendenti in Lean Thinking, principi di eccellenza operativa, Visual Management e risoluzione dei problemi strutturati.
• Agire come agente di cambiamento per promuovere una cultura di responsabilità, miglioramento continuo e eccellenza operativa.
• Assicurare una corretta attuazione di iniziative di miglioramento nel tempo, nel budget e con risultati sostenibili. Qualificazioni Istruzione
• Laurea o superiore in Ingegneria, Scienze Naturali, Business Administration, o una disciplina relativa; l'esperienza equivalente in un ambiente regolamentato GMP può essere considerato.
• Preferito la certificazione Lean/Kaizen e Six Sigma. Esperienza
• Minimo 5 anni di esperienza nel miglioramento continuo, eccellenza operativa, produzione, catena di fornitura, o qualità.
• Provato record di traccia nelle principali iniziative di miglioramento interfunzionale e offrendo risultati aziendali misurabili.
• Esperienza in ambienti di produzione regolati da GMP. Competenze
• Forte competenza in Lean, Six Sigma, gestione delle prestazioni e problem-so strutturato

Spécialiste principal de l'IC – Volume de valeur Fonction Êtes-vous passionné par l'excellence opérationnelle et la transformation des performances par l'amélioration continue? En tant que spécialiste principal de l'IC, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans l'élaboration de la performance future de Value Stream Bulk en faisant progresser le système d'exploitation de la LSC (COS), en favorisant une culture d'amélioration continue et en facilitant la prise de décisions axées sur les données dans l'ensemble de l'organisation. De l'exécution shopfloor à la gestion des performances et la transformation numérique, vous aiderez à renforcer la conformité, la qualité, la sécurité, la livraison, l'efficacité et la fiabilité opérationnelle. • Expérience dans les environnements de fabrication réglementés par les BPF. Compétences
• Forte expertise en Lean, Six Sigma, gestion des performances et gestion structurée des problèmes

jobs.description:
Wir suchen eine(n) motivierte(n) Associate Scientist / Senior Laboratory Specialist welche(r) unser Pilot Plant Bern Team verstärkt. In dieser Rolle übernimmst du eine zentrale Funktion bei der Hochskalierung von Entwicklungsprozessen, die künftig in unseren Produktionsanlagen implementiert werden, sowie bei der Durchführung und Weiterentwicklung etablierter Prozesse im Rahmen des Lifecycle Managements. Innerhalb der Pilot Plant arbeiten wir kontinuierlich an der Optimierung bestehender Prozesse, mit besonderem Fokus auf Effizienz, Robustheit und Skalierbarkeit.

HAUPTAUFGABEN

• Verantwortlich für die Durchführung einer Vielzahl von routinemäßigen und nicht routinemäßigen Anlage-/Labor-arbeiten in einer Anlage welche als Reinraumklasse D eingestuft ist.

• Praxisfokus: Eigenständige Bedienung, Steuerung und Reinigung von Prozessanlagen und Equipment (z.B. Chromatografieanlagen, Ultra-/Diafiltrationssysteme, mobile Kessel und andere Prozessanlagen). Durchführung von kleineren Methodenanpassungen, manuelle Operationen wie Säulenanschluss und das Einspülen von Puffer

• Dokumentationswesen: Dokumentationswesen bzw. gute Dokumentationspraxis (GDP): Dokumentation/Kontrolle von Ergebnissen, Erstellung/Überarbeitung von Batchdokumentation und Standardarbeitsanweisungen

• Prozessumsetzung: Flexibler Aufbau und bedarfsgerechte Anpassung von Prozessanlagen/-aufbauten nach Vorgabe und in enger Abstimmung mit Vorgesetzten.

• Eigenständige Durchführung von Versuchen und Überwachung des Prozessverlaufs, der bei Bedarf eingreifen erfordert

• Durchführung und Organisation von Kalibrierungen und Instandhaltungen sowie deren Bearbeitung in SAP.

• Durchführung von analytischen Messungen

• Zubereitung von Pufferlösungen und Packen von Chromatografiesäulen

• Unterstützung und Einarbeitung weniger erfahrener Mitarbeitender

Qualifikationen

• Laborantenausbildung, Bachelorabschluss, oder vergleichbarer Hochschulabschluss in einem relevanten Bereich. Diese Abschlüsse sind nicht zwingend nötig, wenn Erfahrung im Chemie, Pharma, oder Lebensmittelbereich besteht.

• Vorteil: Arbeitserfahrung innerhalb Reinraumklasse D

• Hoch motiviert und starke zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten

• Teamfähigkeit, aber auch unabhängiges arbeiten

• Zielorientiertes Handeln

• Gutes Verständnis von Microsoft Word und Excel von Vorteil

• Lösungsorientiert Arbeiten

• Anpassungsfähigkeit

• Zeitliche Flexibilität (Temporär Schichtmodelle)

• Kommunikations- und Organisationsfähigkeit

• Sprachen: Gute Deutsch- oder Englischkenntnisse

descriptionByLocale.it:
Stiamo cercando uno scienziato associato motivato / Senior Laboratory Specialist che si unirà al nostro team di Pilot Plant Bern. In questo ruolo, assumerai un ruolo centrale nell'aumento dei processi di sviluppo che saranno implementati nelle nostre strutture produttive in futuro, nonché nell'implementazione e nello sviluppo di processi consolidati nel quadro della gestione del ciclo di vita. All'interno di Pilot Plant, lavoriamo continuamente sull'ottimizzazione dei processi esistenti, con particolare attenzione all'efficienza, alla robustezza e alla scalabilità. TASK PRINCIPALI
• Responsabile per l'esecuzione di una pluralità di routine e non-routine pianta/lavoratori in una pianta classificata come classe di cleanroom D.
• Focus pratico: Funzionamento indipendente, controllo e pulizia di impianti e attrezzature di processo (ad esempio impianti di cromatografia, sistemi di ultra-/diafiltrazione, caldaie mobili e altri impianti di processo). Esegui le regolazioni dei metodi minori, le operazioni manuali come la connessione della colonna e il lavaggio del buffer
• Documentazione: documentazione o buona pratica di documentazione (PIL): documentazione/controllo dei risultati, preparazione/revisione della documentazione batch e procedure operative standard
• Esecuzione del processo: progettazione flessibile e adattamento basato sulle esigenze di impianti/strutture di processo secondo le specifiche e in stretto coordinamento con i supervisori.
• Esecuzione indipendente di test e monitoraggio della sequenza di processo, che richiede intervento se necessario
• Attuazione e organizzazione di tarature e manutenzione e loro lavorazione in SAP.
• Performance delle misurazioni analitiche
• Preparazione di soluzioni tampone e imballaggio di colonne cromatografiche
• Supporto e formazione dei dipendenti meno esperti Qualifiche
• Formazione di laboratorio, laurea, o grado universitario comparabile in un campo rilevante. Questi gradi non sono obbligatori se c'è esperienza nel settore chimico, farmaceutico o alimentare.
• Vantaggio: Esperienza di lavoro nella classe cleanroom D
• Competenze interpersonali altamente motivate e forti
• Lavoro di squadra, ma anche lavoro indipendente
• Azione orientata al gol
• Buona comprensione dei vantaggi Microsoft Word e Excel
• Lavoro orientato alla soluzione
• Adaptability
• Flessibilità temporanea (modelli a strati temporanei)
• Comunicazione e capacità organizzativa
• Lingue: Buona conoscenza di tedesco o inglese Informazioni su CSL Behring CSL Behring è un leader globale di biotherapeutics guidato dalla nostra promessa di salvare vite. Concentrati sulle esigenze dei pazienti utilizzando le più recenti tecnologie, scopriamo, sviluppiamo e forniamo terapie innovative per le persone che vivono con condizioni di immunologia, ematologia, cardiovascolare e metabolica, respiratoria e trapianto aree terapeutiche. Utilizziamo tre piattaforme scientifiche strategiche di frazionamento del plasma, tecnologia delle proteine ricombinanti, e terapia cellulare e genica per supportare l'innovazione continua e perfezionare continuamente i modi in cui i prodotti possono affrontare bisogni medici non soddisfatti e aiutare i pazienti a condurre una vita piena. CSL Behring gestisce una delle più grandi reti di raccolta al plasma del mondo, CSL Plasma. La nostra società madre, CSL, con sede a Melbourne, Australia, impiega 32.000 persone, e fornisce le sue terapie salvavita per le persone in più di 100 paesi. Per saperne di più su CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus e CSL Vifor visita https://www.csl.com/ e CSL Plasma all'indirizzo https://www.cslplasma.com/ . descriptionByLocale.fr:
Nous sommes à la recherche d'un scientifique associé/spécialiste de laboratoire principal motivé qui se joindra à notre équipe pilote Plante Berne. Dans ce rôle, vous jouerez un rôle central dans l'élargissement des processus de développement qui seront mis en œuvre dans nos installations de production à l'avenir, ainsi que dans la mise en œuvre et le développement des processus établis dans le cadre de la gestion du cycle de vie. Au sein de l'usine pilote, nous travaillons en permanence à l'optimisation des processus existants, avec un accent particulier sur l'efficacité, la robustesse et l'évolutivité. PRINCIPAUX TÂCHES
• Responsable de la réalisation d'une pluralité de travaux de routine et non routiniers dans une usine classée classe D.
• Objectif pratique: Exploitation, contrôle et nettoyage indépendants des installations et équipements de traitement (p. ex. les installations de chromatographie, les systèmes d'ultra-/diafiltration, les chaudières mobiles et autres installations de traitement). Effectuer des ajustements de méthode mineurs, des opérations manuelles telles que la connexion à la colonne et le rinçage du tampon
• Documentation: documentation ou bonne pratique en matière de documentation (PIB): documentation/contrôle des résultats, préparation/révision de la documentation par lots et procédures opérationnelles normalisées
• Mise en œuvre du processus: Conception flexible et adaptation des installations/structures en fonction des besoins selon les spécifications et en étroite coordination avec les superviseurs.
• Exécution indépendante des essais et surveillance de la séquence du procédé, ce qui nécessite une intervention si nécessaire
• Mise en œuvre et organisation des étalonnages et de la maintenance et leur traitement dans SAP.
• Résultats des mesures analytiques
• Préparation des solutions tampons et emballage des colonnes chromatographiques
• Soutien et formation des employés moins expérimentés Compétences
• Formation en laboratoire, baccalauréat ou diplôme universitaire comparable dans un domaine pertinent. Ces diplômes ne sont pas obligatoires s'il existe une expérience dans le secteur des produits chimiques, pharmaceutiques ou alimentaires.
• Avantage: Expérience de travail dans une salle propre classe D
• Compétences interpersonnelles très motivées et fortes
• Travail d'équipe, mais aussi travail indépendant
• Mesures orientées vers les objectifs
• Bonne compréhension des avantages de Microsoft Word et Excel
• Travaux axés sur les solutions
• Capacité d'adaptation
• Flexibilité temporelle (modèles de couches temporaires)
• Capacité de communication et d'organisation
• Langues: Bonne connaissance de l'allemand ou de l'anglais À propos de CSL Behring CSL Behring est un chef de file mondial en biothérapeutique animé par notre promesse de sauver des vies. Concentré sur les besoins des patients en utilisant les dernières technologies, nous découvrons, développons et fournissons des thérapies innovantes pour les personnes vivant dans des conditions dans les domaines immunologiques, hématologiques, cardiovasculaires et métaboliques, respiratoires et transplantés. Nous utilisons trois plateformes scientifiques stratégiques de fractionnement plasmatique, la technologie des protéines recombinantes et la thérapie cellulaire et génique pour soutenir l'innovation continue et affiner continuellement les façons dont les produits peuvent répondre aux besoins médicaux non satisfaits et aider les patients à mener une vie entière. CSL Behring exploite l'un des plus grands réseaux mondiaux de collecte de plasma, CSL Plasma. Notre société mère, CSL, dont le siège social est à Melbourne, en Australie, emploie 32 000 personnes et livre ses thérapies vitales à des personnes dans plus de 100 pays. jobs.title: Director, Statistical Programming
jobs.description:
The Director, Statistical Programming provides leadership and expertise in driving the development and maintenance of the CSL statistical programming capabilities which is required to meet regulatory obligations. Manages a team of programmers supporting clinical trial and integrated analyses, annual reporting, regulatory responses, publications, HTA requests and other purposes as needed within one or more therapeutic areas.
The individual will work closely with the Senior Director, Clinical and Statistical Programming to advance the internal programming environment and statistical programming processes. Works closely with Statisticians to ensure that deliverables provided by internal resources or outside providers (CROs; FSP providers) are accurate and aligned with CSL standards.
Reporting Relationships: List other positions in the company that are reporting into this position or that this position reports into.

Main Responsibilities and Accountabilities:

• Working with the Biometrics Programming Leadership team, assess upcoming activities and resulting resource needs and allocate projects to people to ensure high quality, timely, delivery. Ensure realistic resource planning.

• Oversee the CRO delivery or manage the in-house programming of data sets, outputs, and DDT files of clinical trials and integrated analysis.

• Coordinating the oversight or in-house programming of exploratory analyses, analyses to support secondary publications, response to regulatory requests, or other ad-hoc requests.

• Manages, hires, and mentors direct reports including annual evaluations and goal setting.

• As a member of the programming leadership team within biometrics, creates, maintains ensures compliance with programming process and strategy to facilitate accurate and timely analysis programming.

• Help bring state of the art programming methods and tools to the organization and drive automation of delivery, including AI.

• Collaborate with Biometrics and other departments to ensure transition points in process are efficient and of high quality.

• Represents the company in outside professional organizations and meetings.

Job Qualifications and Experience Requirements:

Education:
• BSc in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics or related area with relevant experience
• Other degrees and certifications considered if commensurate with related programming experience.

Experience:
• At least 10 years of experience in the biotech, pharma, or CRO industries
• Preferred 5 or more years of direct supervisory experience
• Experience with CRO management and/or CRO work experience
• Extensive understanding of clinical programming and/or statistical programming processes and standards
• Advanced Experiences with statistical programming using the SAS software including development and use of SAS Macros, preferred managing team performing these activities as well
• Advanced knowledge in CDISC standards (CDASH, SDTM, ADaM)
• Proven ability to work effectively both independently or in a team setting, and to meet set goals by managing own timelines
• Experience in working in cross-functional, multicultural and international clinical trial teams
Competencies
• Coding in SAS, including SAS macro language
• Interest and/or experience in expanding beyond SAS as the primary programming delivery tool
• Experience in and passion for automatization of routine programming tasks
• Broad knowledge of clinical development and processes
• Strong interpersonal and communication skills (verbal and written in English), comfortable around senior management
• Ability to collaboratively work and provide leadership in matrix environment
• A solutions oriented mindset
• Fluency in technical requirements for CDISC compatible datasets and DDT files
• Presentations of programming techniques at professional conferences is a plus

The expected base salary range for this position at hiring is $239,000 - $308,000. Please note this salary range reflects the minimum and maximu

Il Direttore, Programmazione Statistica fornisce leadership e competenze nel guidare lo sviluppo e la manutenzione delle capacità di programmazione statistica CSL necessarie per soddisfare gli obblighi normativi. Gestisce un team di programmatori che supportano analisi cliniche e integrate, report annuali, risposte normative, pubblicazioni, richieste HTA e altri scopi, se necessario in una o più aree terapeutiche. L'individuo lavorerà a stretto contatto con il direttore senior, la programmazione clinica e statistica per far progredire l'ambiente di programmazione interna e i processi di programmazione statistica. Lavora a stretto contatto con Statistici per garantire che i prodotti forniti da risorse interne o da fornitori esterni (CRO; fornitori FSP) siano accurati e allineati con gli standard CSL. Reporting Relationships: Elenca altre posizioni nella società che stanno segnalando in questa posizione o che questa posizione riporta in. Responsabilità e responsabilità principali:
• Lavorare con il team di Leadership di Programmazione Biometrica, valutare le prossime attività e le esigenze delle risorse risultanti e assegnare progetti alle persone per garantire alta qualità, tempestiva, consegna. Assicurare una pianificazione realistica delle risorse.
• Controllare la consegna CRO o gestire la programmazione interna di set di dati, uscite e file DDT di studi clinici e analisi integrata.
• Coordinamento della supervisione o della programmazione interna di analisi esplorative, analisi per sostenere le pubblicazioni secondarie, risposta alle richieste di regolamentazione o altre richieste ad-hoc.
• Gestisce, assume e mentori relazioni dirette, comprese le valutazioni annuali e l'impostazione degli obiettivi.
• Come membro del team di leadership di programmazione all'interno di biometria, crea, mantiene assicura il rispetto del processo di programmazione e della strategia per facilitare la programmazione accurata e tempestiva dell'analisi.
• Aiuta a portare lo stato dei metodi di programmazione dell'arte e strumenti per l'organizzazione e l'automazione del drive di consegna, tra cui AI.
• Collaborare con Biometrics e altri dipartimenti per garantire che i punti di transizione nel processo siano efficienti e di alta qualità.
• Rappresenta l'azienda in organizzazioni e riunioni professionali esterne. Qualifiche di lavoro e requisiti di esperienza: Istruzione:
• Laurea in Scienze informatiche, Matematica, Statistica o area correlata con esperienza rilevante
• Altri gradi e certificazioni considerate se commisurate con relativa esperienza di programmazione. Esperienza:
• Almeno 10 anni di esperienza nelle industrie biotecnologiche, farmaceutiche o CRO
• Preferito 5 o più anni di esperienza di supervisione diretta
• Esperienza con gestione CRO e/o esperienza lavorativa CRO
• Ampia comprensione dei processi e degli standard di programmazione clinica e/o di programmazione statistica
• Esperienze avanzate con la programmazione statistica utilizzando il software SAS compreso lo sviluppo e l'uso di SAS Macros, ha preferito il team di gestione eseguendo queste attività pure
• Conoscenza avanzata negli standard CDISC (CDASH, SDTM, ADaM)
• Prova capacità di lavorare efficacemente sia in modo indipendente che in un ambiente di squadra, e di soddisfare gli obiettivi impostati gestendo le proprie linee temporali
• Esperienza nel lavoro in team di sperimentazione clinica interfunzionali, multiculturali e internazionali Competenze
• Coding in SAS, compreso il linguaggio macro SAS
• Interessi e/o esperienza nell'espansione al di là del SAS come strumento principale di programmazione
• Esperienza e passione per l'automatizzazione dei compiti di programmazione di routine
• Ampia conoscenza dello sviluppo e dei processi clinici
• Forte capacità interpersonali e di comunicazione (verbale e scritto in inglese), confortevole intorno alla gestione senior
• Capacità di lavorare collaborativamente e fornire leadership nell'ambiente matrice
• Una mentalità orientata alle soluzioni
• Fluency in requisiti tecnici per set di dati compatibili CDISC e file DDT
• Presentazioni di tecniche di programmazione a conferenze professionali è un plus La gamma di stipendio base prevista per questa posizione a noleggio è $239,000 - $308,000. Si prega di notare che questa gamma di stipendio riflette il minimo e maximu

descriptionByLocale.de:
Der Direktor, Statistische Programmplanung bietet Führung und Know-how bei der Entwicklung und Wartung der CSL statistische Programmierung Fähigkeiten, die erforderlich ist, um regulatorische Verpflichtungen zu erfüllen. Verwaltet ein Team von Programmierern, die klinische Studien und integrierte Analysen, jährliche Berichterstattung, regulatorische Reaktionen, Veröffentlichungen, HTA-Anfragen und andere Zwecke unterstützen, die in einem oder mehreren therapeutischen Bereichen benötigt werden. Die Person wird eng mit dem Senior Director, Clinical and Statistical Programming, zusammenarbeiten, um die interne Programmierumgebung und die statistischen Programmierprozesse voranzutreiben. Arbeitet eng mit Statistikern zusammen, um sicherzustellen, dass die von internen Ressourcen oder externen Anbietern (CROs; FSP-Anbietern) bereitgestellten Ergebnisse korrekt sind und an den CSL-Standards ausgerichtet sind. Berichterstattungsbeziehungen: Listen Sie andere Positionen im Unternehmen auf, die in diese Position berichten oder in die diese Position berichtet. Hauptzuständigkeiten und Verantwortlichkeiten:
• Arbeiten Sie mit dem Führungsteam für biometrische Programmierung zusammen, bewerten Sie bevorstehende Aktivitäten und den daraus resultierenden Ressourcenbedarf und weisen Sie die Projekte den Menschen zu, um eine qualitativ hochwertige, rechtzeitige Lieferung zu gewährleisten. Gewährleistung einer realistischen Ressourcenplanung.
• Beaufsichtigen Sie die CRO-Bereitstellung oder verwalten Sie die interne Programmierung von Datensätzen, Outputs und DDT-Dateien von klinischen Studien und integrierten Analysen.
• Koordinierung der Überwachung oder internen Programmierung von Sondierungsanalysen, Analysen zur Unterstützung sekundärer Veröffentlichungen, Reaktionen auf regulatorische Anfragen oder andere Ad-hoc-Anträge.
• Verwaltet, stellt und Mentoren direkte Berichte, einschließlich jährlicher Bewertungen und Zielsetzungen.
• Als Mitglied des Programmier-Führungsteams im Bereich Biometrie, erstellt und pflegt die Einhaltung des Programmierprozesses und der Strategie, um eine genaue und zeitnahe Analyseprogrammierung zu ermöglichen.
• Helfen Sie dabei, modernste Programmiermethoden und Tools in die Organisation zu bringen und die Automatisierung der Lieferung, einschließlich KI, voranzutreiben.
• Arbeiten Sie mit Biometrics und anderen Abteilungen zusammen, um sicherzustellen, dass Übergangspunkte im Prozess effizient und von hoher Qualität sind.
• Repräsentiert das Unternehmen in externen Fachorganisationen und Meetings. Berufsqualifikationen und Erfahrungsanforderungen: Bildung:
• BSc in Informatik, Mathematik, Statistik oder verwandten Bereichen mit relevanten Erfahrungen
• Andere Abschlüsse und Zertifizierungen, die in Betracht gezogen werden, wenn sie der damit verbundenen Programmiererfahrung entsprechen. Erfahrung:
• Mindestens 10 Jahre Erfahrung in den Branchen Biotech, Pharma oder CRO
• Bevorzugt 5 oder mehr Jahre direkte Aufsichtserfahrung
• Erfahrung mit CRO Management und/oder CRO Berufserfahrung
• Umfangreiches Verständnis der klinischen Programmierung und/oder der statistischen Programmierungsprozesse und Standards
• Fortgeschrittene Erfahrungen mit der statistischen Programmierung mit der SAS-Software, einschließlich der Entwicklung und Verwendung von SAS Macros, bevorzugtes Managementteam, das auch diese Aktivitäten durchführt
• Fortgeschrittene Kenntnisse in CDISC-Standards (CDASH, SDTM, ADaM)
• Bewährte Fähigkeit, sowohl unabhängig als auch im Team effektiv zu arbeiten und gesetzte Ziele durch die Verwaltung eigener Zeitpläne zu erreichen
• Erfahrung in der Arbeit in crossfunktionalen, multikulturellen und internationalen klinischen Studienteams Kompetenzen
• Codierung in SAS, einschließlich SAS Makrosprache
• Interesse und / oder Erfahrung bei der Erweiterung über SAS als primäres Tool zur Bereitstellung von Programmierung hinaus
• Erfahrung und Leidenschaft für die Automatisierung von Routine-Programmieraufgaben
• Breites Wissen über klinische Entwicklung und Prozesse
• Starke zwischenmenschliche und kommunikative Fähigkeiten (verbal und auf Englisch geschrieben), komfortabel in der Geschäftsleitung
• Fähigkeit zur Zusammenarbeit und Führung in Matrix-Umgebung
• Eine lösungsorientierte Denkweise
• Fließende technische Anforderungen an CDISC-kompatible Datensätze und DDT-Dateien
• Präsentationen von Programmiertechniken auf Fachkonferenzen sind ein Plus Die erwartete Grundgehaltsspanne für diese Position bei der Einstellung ist $ 239.000 - $ 308.000. Bitte beachten Sie, dass diese Gehaltsspanne das Minimum und das Maximum widerspiegelt

Gère une équipe de programmeurs appuyant les essais cliniques et les analyses intégrées, les rapports annuels, les réponses réglementaires, les publications, les demandes de HTA et d'autres fins au besoin dans un ou plusieurs domaines thérapeutiques. La personne travaillera en étroite collaboration avec le directeur principal, Programmation clinique et statistique pour faire progresser l'environnement de programmation interne et les processus de programmation statistique. Collabore étroitement avec les statisticiens pour s'assurer que les produits livrables fournis par des ressources internes ou des fournisseurs extérieurs (OCR; fournisseurs de FSP) sont exacts et conformes aux normes du CSL. Rapports hiérarchiques : énumérez les autres postes de l'entreprise qui relèvent de ce poste ou de ce poste. Principales responsabilités et responsabilités :

Assurer une planification réaliste des ressources.

• Coordonner la surveillance ou la programmation interne d'analyses exploratoires, d'analyses à l'appui de publications secondaires, de réponses aux demandes réglementaires ou d'autres demandes ponctuelles.
• Gérer, embaucher et encadrer des rapports directs, y compris des évaluations annuelles et l'établissement d'objectifs.

• Autres diplômes et certifications considérés s'ils sont proportionnels à l'expérience de programmation connexe. Expérience :

• Expérience de la gestion des CRO et/ou de l'expérience de travail des CRO

jobs.description:
The Process Development Lead is a key leadership role within Technical Operations, responsible for leading global process development teams and driving the development, optimization, and implementation of robust and scalable manufacturing processes for plasma-derived biotherapeutics.
This role combines strong people leadership, technical expertise, and strategic execution to deliver early- to late-stage development programs, lifecycle management activities, and innovation initiatives aligned with CSL’s product portfolio and Quality by Design (QbD) principles.

Main Responsibilities & Accountabilities

• Accountable for the development and execution of short- to mid-term strategies for drug substance process development, including new product introduction and lifecycle management activities

• Provide technical and project leadership for process development activities from pre-clinical stage through product launch across the plasma-derived portfolio

• Lead process development for major manufacturing changes to unit operations, ensuring robust, scalable, and compliant processes

• Drive the assessment, selection, and implementation of innovative technologies to improve process performance, scalability, and product quality

• Promote and embed a Quality by Design (QbD) development approach, ensuring alignment with regulatory expectations and internal standards

• Act as a change agent to advance new ways of working, including adoption of advanced manufacturing and digital approaches

• Lead Process Development execution activities and ensure alignment with project governance and portfolio priorities

• Ensure preparation, review, and approval of high-quality technical documentation and regulatory submissions

• Collaborate closely with Process Engineering, Manufacturing, and other stakeholders to ensure effective scale-up, technology transfer, and facility fit assessments

• Oversee and ensure successful transfer of processes from development to commercial manufacturing

• Engage with external partners (CROs, vendors) to optimize capabilities, resources, and project outcomes

• Lead and Manages team of employees with respect to resource planning and staff allocation to projects involving the discovery, development and manufacture of new products as well as improvements to existing products.

• Drive talent development, succession planning, and capability building within the organization

• Foster a high-performance culture focused on scientific excellence, collaboration, and accountability

• Ensure execution of development activities in alignment with project timelines, quality standards, and regulatory requirements

• Drive continuous improvement of processes, tools, and ways of working within the function

• Ensure compliance with GMP, internal procedures, and regulatory expectations

Qualifications & Experience

• Required: Postgraduate degree (preferably PhD) in Life Sciences, Engineering, or related discipline

• Extensive experience in biotechnology, pharmaceutical industry, or relevant academic environment

• 10+ years of relevant experience in process development, manufacturing, or related fields

• Proven experience leading teams and managing complex, cross-functional programs

• Demonstrated ability to lead and develop high-performing teams in a global, matrixed environment

• Experience across early- to late-stage development, including scale-up, tech transfer, and regulatory submissions

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills

• Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and influencing skills

• Experience working in multicultural, international environments

jobs.description:
Position Summary
The Senior Director, Head of Medical Evidence reports into the Vice President, Head of Disease Areas and coordinates with Medical Affairs and cross-functional stakeholders to lead the Integrated Evidence Generation Plans (IEGP) for all marketed products and oversees the design and implementation of Medical Affairs evidence generation projects in alignment with GxP and business strategy.

Main Responsibilities and Accountabilities

• Responsible for oversight and delivery of the strategic integrated evidence generation plans (IEGPs) across therapeutic areas for pipeline and marketed medicines. This includes development, execution, and maintenance of data gap generation and analysis and governance and documentation of all IEGPs.

• Oversee design and implementation of Medical Affairs-led real-world evidence (RWE), epidemiological studies, HEOR, patient preference, and non-interventional studies. Guide development of phase IIIb/IV trials, registries, and observational studies. Ensure quality and timely delivery of study protocols, statistical analysis plans, and reports.

• Anticipate evidence gaps and proactively adjust tactical plans to serve the data needs of key stakeholders, including Regulatory authorities, HTAs, HCPs, and payers.

• Ensure all activities comply with GCP, regulatory standards, and internal policies. Manage budgets, timelines, and vendor relationships. Monitor and report on the impact of evidence generation activities.

• Oversees study tracking of all ongoing Medical Affairs evidence generation projects globally and provides regular reporting to Medical Affairs, including LT, MAST, DA leads.

• Enhance Medical Affairs capabilities in lifecycle management and phase 3b evidence generation.

• Partner with Global Program Teams, Medical Affairs, Clinical Development, Regulatory, and Market Access. Lead or contribute to matrix teams and evidence generation sub-teams. Provides subject matter expertise and consultation to Medical Affairs colleagues in study development and design and interact, as required, with external research partners including investigators and vendors (including but not limited to CROs, database owners, registries, et). Provide support to Medical Disease Area teams for study execution as required.

Qualifications

Education:

• Advanced degree (MS/PhD/PharmD) with relevant scientific/medical background

Experience:

• Minimum of 12 years in pharmaceutical/biopharmaceutical industry inclusive of Medical Affairs.

• 8+ years’ experience in research related experience and/or pharmaceutical industry experience.

• Experience with late-stage clinical studies, research collaborations and RWE Proven track record of strong leadership, project management and demonstrated ability to coach and mentor individuals.

• Strong Regulatory and medical information communications knowledge and experience.

• Ability to communicate and interact thoughtfully, transparently, and appropriately with a variety of stakeholders both internal and external.

• Experience building and leading cross-functional team in a global matrix organization.

Competencies:

• Analytical thinking

• Business acumen

• Customer focus

• Communication clarity

• Emotional Intelligence (EQ)

• Perseverance

• Presentation expertise

• Priority setting

• Scientific expertise

The expected base salary range for this position at hiring is $303,000 - $371,000. Please note this salary range reflects the minimum and maximum base pay that CSL expects to pay for this position in Waltham, MA as of the time of this posting. Individual base salary for a successful candidate is determined by qualifications, skill level, experience, competencies and other relevant factors. In addition to base salary, total compensation for this role may also include incentive compensation and equity.

Fornire supporto ai team di Area Malattia Medica per l'esecuzione di studio come richiesto. Qualifiche Istruzione:
• Grado avanzato (MS/PhD/PharmD) con relativo background scientifico/medico Esperienza:
• Minimo di 12 anni nell'industria farmaceutica/biofarmaceutica inclusi gli Affari medici.
• Esperienza di 8+ anni nell’esperienza di ricerca e/o nell’industria farmaceutica.
• Esperienza con studi clinici di fine fase, collaborazioni di ricerca e RWE Proven track record di forte leadership, la gestione del progetto e la capacità dimostrata di coach e persone mentore.
• Forte conoscenza e esperienza delle comunicazioni e delle informazioni mediche e regolamentari.
• Capacità di comunicare e interagire con pensiero, trasparenza, e in modo appropriato con una varietà di stakeholder sia interni che esterni.
• Esperienza di costruzione e leader team interfunzionale in un'organizzazione di matrice globale. Competenze:

• Competenza di presentazione
• Impostazione prioritaria

jobs.description:
Two Directors of Search & Evaluation to lead strategic sourcing and evaluation of external innovation opportunities in Hematology, and Cardiovascular/Renal therapeutic areas. Embedded within each Therapeutic Area Leadership Team (TALT), these leaders will identify and advance high-potential assets from preclinical through Phase 1 clinical stages, shape early partnering strategies, and drive transactions in collaboration with Business Development ​

We have a hybrid office/home working model. The position will be based in Zurich (preferred) or Maidenhead, UK, with significant business travel

Main Responsibilities & Accountabilities ​

• Serve as the senior Early S&E leader within the TALT, influencing therapeutic strategy and ensuring external innovation priorities are integrated into portfolio planning. ​

• Lead proactive sourcing and scouting efforts for preclinical and Phase 1 assets, building a robust pipeline of opportunities aligned with TA strategy. ​

• Co-lead internal meetings (with Late Search Lead) focused on evaluating and prioritizing New Product Opportunities (NPOs) within each CSL’s therapeutic areas. NPO meetings are strategic checkpoints where cross-functional teams review potential assets identified by Search and decide whether to advance them for further due diligence and deal negotiations ​

• Develop and execute early partnering strategies, including onboarding approaches and competitive positioning for priority assets. ​

• Drive cross-functional due diligence for each opportunity, coordinating scientific, clinical, regulatory, and commercial assessments to inform governance decisions. ​

• Transaction Execution: Partner closely with BD and Regional Ecosystem Leads to advance high-priority opportunities through negotiation and deal close, ensuring seamless handoff and execution ​

• Represent the TA externally, leading sourcing activities at specialized conferences and cultivating relationships with biotech, academia, and investment communities. ​

Qualifications & Experience Requirements ​

• Significant tenure in biopharma with significant experience in external innovation, search & evaluation, or business development. ​

• Advanced degree required (PhD, MD, or equivalent). ​

• Must have Deep scientific expertise in Hematology or Cardiovascular/Renal therapeutic areas. ​

• Proven track record of leading due diligence and closing early-stage deals. ​

• Strong network within biotech, academia, and pharma BD organizations. ​

About CSL Behring
CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives.

CSL Behring operates one of the world’s largest plasma collection networks, CSL Plasma. Our parent company, CSL, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs 32,000 people, and delivers its lifesaving therapies to people in more than 100 countries.
To learn more about CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus and CSL Vifor visit https://www.csl.com/ and CSL Plasma at https://www.cslplasma.com/ .

Our Benefits
For more information on CSL benefits visit How CSL Supports Your Well-being | CSL .

You Belong at CSL
At CSL, Inclusion and Belonging is at the core of our mission and who we are. It fuels our innovation day in and day out. By celebrating our differences and creating a culture of curiosity and empathy, we are able to better understand and connect with our patients and donors, foster strong relationships with our stakeholders, and sustain a diverse workforc

## Mansioni - Serve as il leader senior di Early S&E all'interno del TALT, influenzando la strategia terapeutica e assicurando che le priorità di innovazione esterna siano integrate nel piano di portafoglio. - Guidare sforzi proattivi di ricerca e scouting per assetti preclinici e di fase 1, costruendo un robusto pipeline di opportunità allineato con la strategia di TA. - Co-guidare riunioni interne (con il Late Search Lead) focalizzate sull'evaluazione e la priorizzazione di Nuove Opportunità di Prodotto (NPO) all'interno di ciascuna area terapeutica di CSL. Le riunioni NPO sono checkpoint strategici dove le squadre cross-funzionali esaminano i potenziali assetti identificati dalla Ricerca e decidono se avanzarli per ulteriori valutazioni e negoziazioni di trattative. - Sviluppare e eseguire strategie di partnering iniziali, comprese le strategie di onboarding e la posizionamento competitivo per gli assetti di priorità. - Guidare la valutazione cross-funzionale per ciascuna opportunità, coordinando le valutazioni scientifiche, cliniche, regolatorie e commerciali per informare le decisioni di governance. - Esecuzione delle trattative: Collaborare strettamente con BD e Regional Ecosystem Leads per avanzare le opportunità di alta priorità attraverso la negoziazione e la chiusura del trattato, assicurando un passaggio senza intoppi e l'esecuzione. - Rappresentare la TA esternamente, guidando le attività di ricerca in conferenze specializzate e coltivando relazioni con la biotecnologia, l'istruzione accademica e le comunità di investimento. ##
• Requisiti e Esperienze - Tenuta significativa nella biotecnologia con esperienza significativa in innovazione esterna, ricerca e valutazione, o sviluppo aziendale. - Laurea specialistica richiesta (PhD, MD, o equivalente). - Deve avere una profonda conoscenza scientifica nelle aree terapeutiche di Ematologia o Cardiovascolare/Renale. - Provenienza di esperienze di leadership nella valutazione e chiusura di trattative iniziali. - Rete forte all'interno della biotecnologia, dell'istruzione accademica e delle organizzazioni di BD farmaceutico. ##
• Cosa offriamo - Modello di lavoro ibrido ufficio/casa. - Posizione basata a Zurigo (preferito) o Maidenhead, Regno Unito, con viaggi d'affari significativi. ## Contatto Per ulteriori informazioni sui benefici di CSL visita [How CSL Supports Your Well-being | CSL](https://www.csl.com/). ## Descrizione CSL Behring è un leader globale di biofarmaceutici guidato dalla nostra promessa di salvare vite. Focalizzati sul servire le esigenze dei pazienti utilizzando le ultime tecnologie, scopriamo, sviluppiamo e consegniamo terapie innovative per le persone che vivono con condizioni nelle aree terapeutiche di immunologia, ematologia, cardiovascolare e metabolica, respiratoria e trapianto. Utilizziamo tre piattaforme scientifiche strategiche di frazionamento del plasma, tecnologia di proteine ricombinanti e terapia cellulare e genica per supportare l'innovazione continua e raffinare continuamente le modalità in cui i prodotti possono affrontare le esigenze mediche non soddisfatte e aiutare i pazienti a condurre vite complete. CSL Behring opera una delle reti di raccolta di plasma più grandi del mondo, CSL Plasma. La nostra società madre, CSL, con sede a Melbourne, Australia, impiega 32.000 persone e consegna le sue terapie salvavita a persone in più di 100 paesi. Per ulteriori informazioni su CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus e CSL Vifor visita [https://www.csl.com/](https://www.csl.com/) e CSL Plasma a [https://www.cslplasma.com/](https://www.cslplasma.com/).

• Exigences et expérience - Une participation importante en biotechnologie avec une expérience importante en innovation externe, en recherche et en évaluation ou en développement commercial. - Demande de diplôme de spécialiste (PhD, MD ou équivalent). - Il doit posséder une connaissance scientifique approfondie dans les domaines thérapeutiques de l'hématologie ou cardio-vasculaire/renal. - Provenance des expériences de leadership dans l'évaluation et la clôture des négociations initiales. - Un réseau solide au sein des organismes de biotechnologie, de formation universitaire et de BD pharmaceutique.
