jobs.description:
As a member of the Finance team, the Finance Business Partner supports TechOps by providing financial insights, analysis, and decision support to enable effective operational and strategic decision-making.

The role partners with TechOps leadership to drive financial planning, performance management, and value delivery, ensuring accurate and timely financial information to support business objectives.

Main Responsibilities and Accountabilities

• Provide forward looking financial insights and recommendations to TechOps leadership, supporting and influencing decision-making on performance, risks, and priorities.

• Lead financial analysis to address complex financial and operational challenges, translating cross-functional insights into actionable business recommendations .Support business cases, project evaluation, and cost/value optimization, navigating ambiguous scenarios with multiple drivers and incomplete data to drive performance and resource allocation. Deliver high-quality financial materials and partner with stakeholders to drive performance steering and accountability.

• Drive planning cycles (budget, forecast, outlook), ensuring alignment with operational priorities and financial targets.

• Perform financial modeling, variance analysis and challenge assumptions to improve forecast accuracy and identify risks and opportunities.

• Support medium- and long-term strategic planning.

Performance & KPI Analysis

• Monitor key financial and operational KPIs, providing clear performance insights to support decision-making.

• Develop concise, insight-driven dashboards and reporting focused on business relevance and usability.

• Ensure data integrity and consistent financial reporting, supporting continuous improvement and standardization.

• Partner effectively with TechOps, FP&A, and Finance teams to drive alignment, communication, and execution of key initiatives.

• Lead financial workflows or projects with TechOps;

• Drive continuous improvement initiatives.

Your Profile

Education

• Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or other Business related discipline

• CPA/CA or MBA a plus

Experience

• 5+ years of experience in various finance roles including, business partnering, financial planning, reporting, accounting operations or related fields, including experience in the biopharmaceutical or manufacturing sector

• Experience with using dashboarding and visualization software (e.g. PowerBi) is preferable

• Experience supporting manufacturing, operations, or project-based functions, preferably within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or life sciences industry.

Competencies

• Strong organizational and stakeholder management skills

• Excellent communication (written and verbal)

• Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities

• Ability to translate complex data into actionable insights

• Strong project and priority management skills

• High attention to detail and data accuracy

• Strong business and financial acumen

• Ability to work independently, drive results, and operate in ambiguity

• portare flussi di lavoro finanziari o progetti con TechOps;

• Promuovere iniziative di miglioramento continuo.

Il tuo profilo

Istruzione

• Corso di laurea in Finanza, Contabilità, o altra disciplina di business correlati

• CPA/CA o MBA un plus

Esperienza

• 5+ anni di esperienza in vari ruoli finanziari tra cui, partner commerciale, pianificazione finanziaria, reporting, operazioni contabili o settori correlati, compresa l'esperienza nel settore biofarmaceutico o manifatturiero

• Esperienza che supporta funzioni produttive, operative o basate su progetti, preferibilmente all'interno dell'industria farmaceutica, biotecnologia o scienze della vita.

Competenze

• Forte capacità organizzative e di gestione degli stakeholder

• Ottima comunicazione (scritta e verbale)

• Forte capacità analitiche e di problem solving

• Capacità di tradurre dati complessi in insight attuabili

descriptionByLocale.en:
As a member of the Finance team, the Finance Business Partner supports TechOps by providing financial insights, analysis, and decision support to enable effective operational and strategic decision-making.

The role partners with TechOps leadership to drive financial planning, performance management, and value delivery, ensuring accurate and timely financial information to support business objectives.

Main Responsibilities and Accountabilities

• Provide forward looking financial insights and recommendations to TechOps leadership, supporting and influencing decision-making on performance, risks, and priorities.

• Lead financial analysis to address complex financial and operational challenges, translating cross-functional insights into actionable business recommendations .Support business cases, project evaluation, and cost/value optimization, navigating ambiguous scenarios with multiple drivers and incomplete data to drive performance and resource allocation. Deliver high-quality financial materials and partner with stakeholders to drive performance steering and accountability.

• Drive planning cycles (budget, forecast, outlook), ensuring alignment with operational priorities and financial targets.

• Perform financial modeling, variance analysis and challenge assumptions to improve forecast accuracy and identify risks and opportunities.

• Support medium- and long-term strategic planning.

Performance & KPI Analysis

• Monitor key financial and operational KPIs, providing clear performance insights to support decision-making.

• Develop concise, insight-driven dashboards and reporting focused on business relevance and usability.

• Ensure data integrity and consistent financial reporting, supporting continuous improvement and standardization.

• Partner effectively with TechOps, FP&A, and Finance teams to drive alignment, communication, and execution of key initiatives.

• Lead financial workflows or projects with TechOps;

• Drive continuous improvement initiatives.

Your Profile

Education

• Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or other Business related discipline

• CPA/CA or MBA a plus

Experience

• 5+ years of experience in various finance roles including, business partnering, financial planning, reporting, accounting operations or related fields, including experience in the biopharmaceutical or manufacturing sector

• Experience with using dashboarding and visualization software (e.g. PowerBi) is preferable

• Experience supporting manufacturing, operations, or project-based functions, preferably within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or life sciences industry.

Competencies

• Strong organizational and stakeholder management skills

• Excellent communication (written and verbal)

• Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities

• Ability to translate complex data into actionable insights

• Strong project and priority management skills

• High attention to detail and data accuracy

• Strong business and financial acumen

• Ability to work independently, drive results, and operate in ambiguity

About CSL Behring
CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives.

CSL Behring operates one of the world’s largest plasma collection networks, CSL Plasma. Our parent company, CSL, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs 32,000 people, and delivers its lifesaving therapies to people in more than 100 countries.
To learn more about CSL, CSL B

jobs.description:
CSL's R&D organization is accelerating innovation to deliver greater impact for patients. With a project-led structure and a focus on collaboration, we’re building a future-ready team that thrives in dynamic biotech ecosystems. Joining CSL now means being part of an agile team committed to developing therapies that make a meaningful difference worldwide.

Could you be our next Senior Director Search & Evaluation Late TA Lead, Immunology? The job is in our Waltham MA, King of Prussia PA, Glattburg Switzerland or Maidenhead UK Office. This is a hybrid position and is onsite three days a week.

Position Description Summary ​

Senior Directors of Search & Evaluation to lead strategic sourcing and evaluation of later-stage external Hematology therapeutic area. You will focus on opportunities from Phase 2 through marketed drugs, requiring deep clinical expertise, strong engagement with external Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) and clinical investigators, and a keen understanding of evolving standards of care. The role is critical to shaping our portfolio through high-impact partnerships and transactions. ​

Main Responsibilities & Accountabilities ​

• Serve as the senior S&E leader within the TALT, influencing therapeutic strategy and integrating late-stage external innovation priorities into portfolio planning. ​

• Lead proactive sourcing efforts for Phase 2 to marketed assets, identifying opportunities that align with TA strategy and unmet medical needs. ​

• Co-lead internal meetings (with Early Search Lead) focused on evaluating and prioritizing New Product Opportunities (NPOs) within each CSL’s therapeutic areas. NPO meetings are strategic checkpoints where cross-functional teams review potential assets identified by Search and decide whether to advance them for further due diligence and deal negotiations ​

• Engage extensively with external KOLs, clinical investigators, and networks to validate asset potential, understand trial designs & clinical endpoints, and anticipate competitive dynamics. ​

• Maintain deep awareness of changing standards of care and competitive landscapes to inform sourcing priorities and deal strategy. ​

• Drive cross-functional due diligence for late-stage assets, coordinating clinical, regulatory, commercial, and market access assessments to support governance decisions. ​

• Partner closely with BD and Regional Ecosystem Leads to advance high-priority opportunities through negotiation and deal close, ensuring seamless handoff and execution ​

• Represent the TA externally, leading sourcing activities at specialized conferences and building relationships with pharma, biotech, and clinical communities. ​

Qualifications & Experience Requirements ​

• 15+ years in biopharma with significant experience in clinical development, external innovation, or business development. ​

• Advanced degree required (MD, PhD, or equivalent). ​

• Deep clinical expertise in Immunology, Hematology, or Cardiovascular/Renal therapeutic areas. ​

• Proven track record of sourcing and closing late-stage deals and engaging with KOLs and clinical networks. ​

• Strong understanding of regulatory pathways, market access, and competitive standards of care. ​

The expected base salary range for this position at hiring is $263,000 - $328,000. Please note this salary range reflects the minimum and maximum base pay that CSL expects to pay for this position at the listed for Waltham MA at the time of this posting. Individual base salary for a successful candidate is determined by qualifications, skill level, experience, competencies and other relevant factors. In addition to base salary, total compensation for this role may also include incentive compensation and equity.

• Rappresentare l'AT all'esterno, guidando attività di sourcing in conferenze specializzate e costruendo rapporti con comunità farmaceutiche, biotecnologiche e cliniche. ​ Qualifiche e requisiti di esperienza ​

• Comprovata esperienza nell'approvvigionamento e nella chiusura di accordi in fase avanzata e nel coinvolgimento di KOL e reti cliniche. ​

Jetzt bei CSL einzusteigen bedeutet, Teil eines agilen Teams zu sein, das sich für die Entwicklung von Therapien einsetzt, die weltweit einen bedeutenden Unterschied machen. Könnten Sie unser nächster Senior Director Search & Evaluation Late TA Lead, Immunology sein? Die Stelle findet in unserem Büro in Waltham MA, King of Prussia PA, Glattburg Schweiz oder Maidenhead UK statt. Es handelt sich um eine Hybridposition, die an drei Tagen in der Woche vor Ort ist. Zusammenfassung der Positionsbeschreibung ​ Senior Directors of Search & Evaluation leiten die strategische Beschaffung und Bewertung des späteren externen Therapiebereichs Hämatologie. Sie konzentrieren sich auf Chancen von Phase 2 bis hin zu vermarkteten Arzneimitteln. Dies erfordert umfassende klinische Fachkenntnisse, eine starke Zusammenarbeit mit externen Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) und klinischen Prüfärzten sowie ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für die sich entwickelnden Pflegestandards. Die Rolle ist entscheidend für die Gestaltung unseres Portfolios durch wirkungsvolle Partnerschaften und Transaktionen. ​ Hauptaufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten ​
• Fungieren Sie als leitender S&E-Leiter innerhalb des TALT, beeinflussen Sie die Therapiestrategie und integrieren Sie externe Innovationsprioritäten in der Spätphase in die Portfolioplanung. ​
• Führen Sie proaktive Beschaffungsbemühungen für Phase 2 zu vermarkteten Vermögenswerten durch und identifizieren Sie Möglichkeiten, die mit der TA-Strategie und ungedeckten medizinischen Bedürfnissen übereinstimmen. ​
• Co-Leitung interner Meetings (mit Early Search Lead), die sich auf die Bewertung und Priorisierung von New Product Opportunities (NPOs) innerhalb der Therapiebereiche jedes CSL konzentrieren. NPO-Meetings sind strategische Kontrollpunkte, an denen funktionsübergreifende Teams potenzielle Assets überprüfen, die von Search identifiziert wurden, und entscheiden, ob sie für weitere Due-Diligence-Prüfungen und Vertragsverhandlungen weiterverwendet werden sollen.
• Arbeiten Sie intensiv mit externen KOLs, klinischen Prüfärzten und Netzwerken zusammen, um das Asset-Potenzial zu validieren, Studiendesigns und klinische Endpunkte zu verstehen und die Wettbewerbsdynamik zu antizipieren. ​
• Behalten Sie ein tiefes Bewusstsein für sich ändernde Pflegestandards und Wettbewerbslandschaften bei, um Beschaffungsprioritäten und Geschäftsstrategien zu informieren. ​
• Fördern Sie die funktionsübergreifende Due Diligence für Vermögenswerte in der Spätphase und koordinieren Sie klinische, regulatorische, kommerzielle und Marktzugangsbewertungen, um Governance-Entscheidungen zu unterstützen. ​
• Arbeiten Sie eng mit BD und regionalen Ökosystem-Leads zusammen, um durch Verhandlungen und Geschäftsabschlüsse Chancen mit hoher Priorität voranzutreiben und eine reibungslose Übergabe und Ausführung sicherzustellen. ​
• Repräsentieren Sie den TA nach außen, leiten Sie Beschaffungsaktivitäten auf Fachkonferenzen und bauen Sie Beziehungen zu Pharma-, Biotech- und klinischen Communities auf. ​ Qualifikations- und Erfahrungsanforderungen ​
• 15+ Jahre in der Biopharmabranche mit umfangreicher Erfahrung in der klinischen Entwicklung, externen Innovation oder Geschäftsentwicklung. ​
• Fortgeschrittener Abschluss erforderlich (MD, PhD oder gleichwertig). ​
• Umfassendes klinisches Fachwissen in den Bereichen Immunologie, Hämatologie oder Herz-Kreislauf-/Nierentherapie. ​
• Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz bei der Beschaffung und dem Abschluss von Spätphasengeschäften sowie der Zusammenarbeit mit KOLs und klinischen Netzwerken. ​
• Ausgeprägtes Verständnis der Regulierungswege, des Marktzugangs und wettbewerbsfähiger Pflegestandards. Die erwartete Grundgehaltsspanne für diese Position liegt bei Einstellung zwischen 263.000 und 328.000 US-Dollar. Bitte beachten Sie, dass diese Gehaltsspanne das minimale und maximale Grundgehalt widerspiegelt, das CSL zum Zeitpunkt dieser Veröffentlichung für diese Position bei Waltham MA zu zahlen erwartet. Das individuelle Grundgehalt eines erfolgreichen Kandidaten wird durch Qualifikationen, Fähigkeitsniveau, Erfahrung, Kompetenzen und andere relevante Faktoren bestimmt. Die Gesamtvergütung für diese Position kann neben dem Grundgehalt auch Anreizvergütung und Eigenkapital umfassen. #LI-HYBRID Über CSL Behring CSL Behring ist ein weltweit führendes Unternehmen im Bereich Biotherapeutika, angetrieben von unserem Versprechen, Leben zu retten. Wir konzentrieren uns darauf, den Bedürfnissen der Patienten durch den Einsatz neuester Technologien gerecht zu werden, und entdecken, entwickeln und liefern innovative Therapien für Menschen mit Erkrankungen
descriptionByLocale.fr:
L'organisation R&D de CSL accélère l'innovation afin d'avoir un plus grand impact pour les patients. Grâce à une structure dirigée par projet et en mettant l’accent sur la collaboration, nous construisons une équipe prête pour l’avenir qui prospère dans des écosystèmes biotechnologiques dynamiques. Rejoindre CSL, c’est désormais faire partie d’une équipe agile engagée à développer des thérapies qui font une différence significative dans le monde entier. Pourriez-vous être notre prochain directeur principal, recherche et évaluation, responsable AT tardif, immunologie ? Le poste se déroule dans nos bureaux de Waltham MA, King of Prussia PA, Glattburg Suisse ou Maidenhead UK. Il s'agit d'un poste hybride et est sur place trois jours par semaine. Résumé de la description du poste Les directeurs principaux de la recherche et de l'évaluation dirigeront l'approvisionnement stratégique et l'évaluation du domaine thérapeutique externe de l'hématologie à un stade ultérieur. Vous vous concentrerez sur les opportunités de la phase 2 jusqu'aux médicaments commercialisés, nécessitant une expertise clinique approfondie, un engagement fort avec les principaux leaders d'opinion (KOL) externes et les enquêteurs cliniques, ainsi qu'une compréhension approfondie de l'évolution des normes de soins. Ce rôle est essentiel pour façonner notre portefeuille grâce à des partenariats et des transactions à fort impact. ​ Principales responsabilités et responsabilités ​
• Servir de leader senior en S&E au sein du TALT, en influençant la stratégie thérapeutique et en intégrant les priorités d'innovation externe à un stade avancé dans la planification du portefeuille. ​
• Diriger les efforts d'approvisionnement proactifs pour la phase 2 vers les actifs commercialisés, en identifiant les opportunités qui correspondent à la stratégie d'AT et aux besoins médicaux non satisfaits. ​
• Codiriger des réunions internes (avec le responsable de la recherche précoce) axées sur l'évaluation et la priorisation des opportunités de nouveaux produits (OBNL) dans les domaines thérapeutiques de chaque CSL. Les réunions des NPO sont des points de contrôle stratégiques où les équipes interfonctionnelles examinent les actifs potentiels identifiés par Search et décident de les faire avancer pour une diligence raisonnable plus approfondie et des négociations commerciales.
• S'engager largement avec des KOL externes, des enquêteurs cliniques et des réseaux pour valider le potentiel des actifs, comprendre les conceptions d'essais et les paramètres cliniques et anticiper la dynamique concurrentielle. ​
• Maintenir une connaissance approfondie de l'évolution des normes de soins et des paysages concurrentiels pour éclairer les priorités d'approvisionnement et la stratégie de transaction. ​
• Mener une diligence raisonnable interfonctionnelle pour les actifs en phase de développement avancé, en coordonnant les évaluations cliniques, réglementaires, commerciales et d'accès au marché pour soutenir les décisions de gouvernance. ​
• Collaborer étroitement avec le BD et les responsables régionaux de l'écosystème pour faire progresser les opportunités hautement prioritaires grâce à la négociation et à la conclusion d'accords, garantissant un transfert et une exécution fluides. ​
• Représenter le TA à l'externe, diriger les activités d'approvisionnement lors de conférences spécialisées et établir des relations avec les communautés pharmaceutique, biotechnologique et clinique. ​ Exigences de qualifications et d'expérience ​
• Plus de 15 ans dans le domaine biopharmaceutique avec une expérience significative en développement clinique, en innovation externe ou en développement commercial. ​
• Diplôme d'études supérieures requis (MD, PhD ou équivalent). ​
• Expertise clinique approfondie dans les domaines thérapeutiques de l'immunologie, de l'hématologie ou des maladies cardiovasculaires/rénales. ​
• Expérience avérée en matière de recherche et de conclusion d'accords à un stade avancé et d'engagement avec des KOL et des réseaux cliniques. ​
• Solide compréhension des voies réglementaires, de l'accès au marché et des normes de soins compétitives. ​ L'échelle salariale de base attendue pour ce poste au moment de l'embauche est de 263 000 $ à 328 000 $. Veuillez noter que cette échelle salariale reflète le salaire de base minimum et maximum que CSL s'attend à payer pour ce poste chez Waltham MA au moment de cette publication. Le salaire de base individuel d'un candidat retenu est déterminé par ses qualifications, son niveau de compétence, son expérience, ses compétences et d'autres facteurs pertinents. En plus du salaire de base, la rémunération totale pour ce rôle peut également inclure une rémunération incitative et des actions. #LI-HYBRID À propos de CSL Behring CSL Behring est un leader mondial des biothérapeutiques animé par notre promesse de sauver des vies. Axés sur la satisfaction des besoins des patients en utilisant les dernières technologies, nous découvrons, développons et proposons des thérapies innovantes pour les personnes vivant avec la maladie.

jobs.description:
Responsibilities:

• You will be responsible for scientific input to clinical development strategies and therapeutic areas.

• Provide scientific and clinical development input for the safe and efficient execution of assigned programs, ensuring the highest quality and full compliance of all outputs.

• Will contribute to the development of the scientific strategy of the clinical development plan, the design of trial related documents and the scientific oversight of clinical trials.

• You will facilitate a team to define and deliver the clinical strategy within programs.

• Define scientific strategy for multiple program components.

• You will lead the development of Clinical Development Program.

• Author clinical study documents and assists with development/critical review of submission documents.

• Contribute to authorship and review of manuscripts and conference abstracts.

• Collaboratively develop the clinical development strategy with project teams, providing input, guidance and mentorship for project teams.

• Contribute to the scientific analysis and interpretation of clinical data and the writing of clinical study reports, internal and external scientific meeting presentations and peer-reviewed publications, and all regulatory submission documents.

• Will foster close collaboration with other departments, defining and improving interfaces to other departments.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Science, Allied Health or Engineering.

• 8+ years experience in the biotechnology or pharmaceutical industry (or where relevant a biomedical research organization).

• 5+ years managing projects.

• In-depth knowledge in the drug development and manufacturing processes for pharmaceuticals (CMC, non-clinical, clinical, Regulatory Affairs).

The role is based in Glattbrugg, Switzerland and requires an onsite presence of 3 days per week.

About CSL Behring
CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives.

CSL Behring operates one of the world’s largest plasma collection networks, CSL Plasma. Our parent company, CSL, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs 32,000 people, and delivers its lifesaving therapies to people in more than 100 countries.
To learn more about CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus and CSL Vifor visit https://www.csl.com/ and CSL Plasma at https://www.cslplasma.com/ .

Our Benefits
For more information on CSL benefits visit How CSL Supports Your Well-being | CSL .

You Belong at CSL
At CSL, Inclusion and Belonging is at the core of our mission and who we are. It fuels our innovation day in and day out. By celebrating our differences and creating a culture of curiosity and empathy, we are able to better understand and connect with our patients and donors, foster strong relationships with our stakeholders, and sustain a diverse workforce that will move our company and industry into the future.
To learn more about inclusion and belonging visit https://www.csl.com/careers/inclusion-and-belonging

Equal Opportunity Employer
CSL is an Equal Opportunity Employer. If you are an individual with a disability and need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process, please visit https://www.csl.com/accessibility-statement .

Responsabilità:

• Sarete responsabili per l'ingresso scientifico alle strategie di sviluppo clinico e aree terapeutiche.

• Fornire input di sviluppo scientifico e clinico per l'esecuzione sicura ed efficiente dei programmi assegnati, garantendo la massima qualità e la piena conformità di tutte le uscite.

• Contribuirà allo sviluppo della strategia scientifica del piano di sviluppo clinico, alla progettazione di documenti relativi alla sperimentazione e alla supervisione scientifica di studi clinici.

• Potrai facilitare un team per definire e fornire la strategia clinica all'interno dei programmi.

• Definire la strategia scientifica per più componenti del programma.

• Condurrai lo sviluppo del Programma di Sviluppo Clinico.

• Autore documenti di studio clinici e assiste con lo sviluppo / revisione critica dei documenti di presentazione.

• Contribuisci all'autore e alla revisione dei manoscritti e degli abstract di conferenze.

• Sviluppare la strategia di sviluppo clinico con i team di progetto, fornendo input, guida e mentorship per i team di progetto.

• Contribuire all'analisi scientifica e all'interpretazione dei dati clinici e alla scrittura di rapporti di studio clinici, presentazioni di incontri scientifici interni ed esterni e pubblicazioni peer-reviewed, e tutti i documenti di presentazione normativa.

• Favorirà una stretta collaborazione con altri reparti, definendo e migliorando le interfacce ad altri reparti.

Qualifiche:

• Laurea o equivalente in Scienze, Salute Alleata o Ingegneria.

• 8+ anni di esperienza nella biotecnologia o nell'industria farmaceutica (o dove pertinente un'organizzazione di ricerca biomedica).

• 5+ anni di gestione dei progetti.

• Conoscenza approfondita dei processi di sviluppo e produzione di farmaci per i prodotti farmaceutici (CMC, non clinici, regolamentari).

Il ruolo si svolge a Glattbrugg, in Svizzera e richiede una presenza in loco di 3 giorni a settimana.

Informazioni su CSL Behring
CSL Behring è un leader globale di biotherapeutics guidato dalla nostra promessa di salvare vite. Concentrati sulle esigenze dei pazienti utilizzando le più recenti tecnologie, scopriamo, sviluppiamo e forniamo terapie innovative per le persone che vivono con condizioni di immunologia, ematologia, cardiovascolare e metabolica, respiratoria e trapianto aree terapeutiche. Utilizziamo tre piattaforme scientifiche strategiche di frazionamento del plasma, tecnologia delle proteine ricombinanti, e terapia cellulare e genica per supportare l'innovazione continua e perfezionare continuamente i modi in cui i prodotti possono affrontare bisogni medici non soddisfatti e aiutare i pazienti a condurre una vita piena.

CSL Behring gestisce una delle più grandi reti di raccolta al plasma del mondo, CSL Plasma. La nostra società madre, CSL, con sede a Melbourne, Australia, impiega 32.000 persone, e fornisce le sue terapie salvavita per le persone in più di 100 paesi.
Per saperne di più su CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus e CSL Viper visita https://www.csl.com/ e CSL Plasma all'indirizzo https://www.cslplasma.com/ .

I nostri vantaggi
Per ulteriori informazioni sui vantaggi CSL visita Come CSL supporta il tuo benessere | CSL .

Condividi su Twitter
A CSL, Inclusione e Belonging è al centro della nostra missione e chi siamo. Esso alimenta la nostra innovazione giorno in e giorno fuori. Festeggiando le nostre differenze e creando una cultura della curiosità e dell'empatia, siamo in grado di comprendere e connetterci meglio con i nostri pazienti e donatori, promuovere relazioni forti con i nostri stakeholder, e sostenere una forza lavoro diversificata che muoverà la nostra azienda e l'industria nel futuro.
Per saperne di più sull'inclusione e la visita di appartenenza https://www.csl.com/careers/inclusion-and-belonging

Equal Opportunity Employer
CSL è un Equal Opportunity Employer. Se sei un individuo con disabilità e hai bisogno di un alloggio ragionevole per qualsiasi parte del processo di applicazione, visita https://www.csl.com/accessibility-statement .

• 5 ans et plus de gestion de projets.

• Connaissance approfondie des processus de développement et de fabrication des médicaments pour les produits pharmaceutiques (CMC, affaires non cliniques, cliniques, réglementaires).

Le rôle est basé à Glattbrugg, en Suisse, et nécessite une présence sur place de 3 jours par semaine.

À propos de CSL Behring
CSL Behring est un chef de file mondial en biothérapeutique animé par notre promesse de sauver des vies. Concentré sur les besoins des patients en utilisant les dernières technologies, nous découvrons, développons et offrons des thérapies innovantes pour les personnes vivant dans des conditions dans les domaines immunologiques, hématologiques, cardiovasculaires et métaboliques, respiratoires et transplantés. Nous utilisons trois plateformes scientifiques stratégiques de fractionnement plasmatique, la technologie des protéines recombinantes et la thérapie cellulaire et génique pour soutenir l'innovation continue et affiner continuellement les façons dont les produits peuvent répondre aux besoins médicaux non satisfaits et aider les patients à mener une vie complète.

CSL Behring exploite l'un des plus grands réseaux mondiaux de collecte de plasma, CSL Plasma. Notre société mère, CSL, dont le siège social est à Melbourne, en Australie, emploie 32 000 personnes et livre ses thérapies vitales à des personnes dans plus de 100 pays.
Pour en savoir plus sur CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus et CSL Vifor, visitez https://www.csl.com/ et CSL Plasma à https://www.cslplasma.com/ .

Nos avantages
Pour plus d'informations sur les avantages de la LSC, visitez Comment la LSC soutient votre bien-être.

Vous appartenez à CSL
Chez CSL, l'inclusion et l'appartenance sont au cœur de notre mission et de ce que nous sommes. Elle alimente notre journée d'innovation en plein jour. En célébrant nos différences et en créant une culture de curiosité et d'empathie, nous sommes en mesure de mieux comprendre nos patients et nos donateurs et d'établir des liens avec eux, de favoriser des relations solides avec nos intervenants et de maintenir une main-d'oeuvre diversifiée qui fera progresser notre entreprise et notre industrie dans l'avenir.
Pour en savoir plus sur l'inclusion et l'appartenance, visitez https://www.csl.com/careers/inclusion-and-appartenant

jobs.title: Director, Operations Lead - Private-Public Partnership (Tolling)
jobs.description:
Role summary
Build and run the operating engine of CSL's PPP ( Public-Private Partnerships ) Centre of Excellence — the governance, methodologies, data, systems and internal network that let CSL evaluate, decide on, and execute government partnership opportunities at speed and as a lean organisation. Partner with the Director, PPP Engagements (Business Development), who leads external government engagement and deal origination, by owning the internal capabilities, processes and infrastructure that make those engagements rigorous, repeatable and well-governed.

A. Methodology, Tools & Decision Frameworks

• Own and continuously improve the toolkit for evaluating government partnership opportunities — standardized business case templates, decision-making criteria - ensuring comparable analysis across markets and service options. Liaise with FBP to ensure that eNPV, P&L and LRP models are synchronized with latest assumptions and information.

• Maintain the PPP Stage Gate methodology, qualification criteria and approval governance, including decision rights at each gate.

• Identify and build new tools and capabilities that increase the CoE's efficiency, resilience and sustainability.

B. Governance & Decision Forums

• Run the operating rhythm of PPP governance: prepare and orchestrate the PPP Taskforce and other Committees (agendas, pre-reads, reusable decks, decisions and action tracking).

• Align the PPP calendar and inputs with enterprise cycles — Strategic Plan, LRP, Market Demand & Capacity Planning — so PPP commitments flow into company forecasts and supply planning, in coordination with Operations.

• Propose evolution of governance or format for connecting with internal stakeholders (Taskforce, leadership, cross-functional alignment).

• Pro-actively identify needs for stakeholder engagement and support organization of these engagements.

C. Pipeline & Portfolio Management

• Maintain a dynamic, qualified opportunity pipeline in close collaboration with the Director, PPP Engagements, enabling a proactive, focused approach to growth.

• Define and operationalize the handoff from opportunity to execution — operational plan, resourcing, timelines, critical milestones, KPIs — with the Engagements Lead and Operations and local market representatives.

D. Data, Systems & Reporting

• Ensure PPP data is captured and maintained in enterprise systems (GTMS, Rapid Response, I360) and in fit-for-purpose databases where no system exists.

• Design and run dashboards together with I&A partners for tracking PPP metrics, pipeline health and existing PPP deals performance for leadership and the PPP Taskforce.

E. Knowledge & Intelligence

• Build and curate a single internal repository for PPP documents, templates, business cases and insights for "One Source of Truth" concept enablement.

• Collaborate closely with the Competitive Intelligence team to maintain competitive and market intelligence (competitor deal structures, pricing, timing) and feed it into decisions and methodology.

• Run a lessons-learned loop on won/lost opportunities to sharpen the framework.

F. Internal Network, Enablement & Advocacy

• Map internal and external stakeholders (roles, RACI, engagement plans) and events (e.g., congresses) supporting PPP commercial development. Establish a yearly plan for external engagements for the PPP CoE team in close collaboration with the Director, PPP Engagements.

• Cultivate the cross-functional network — Commercial, Strategy, Finance, Legal/E&C, PAGA, Operations, Plasma/Supply Chain etc.

• Build internal awareness of CSL's PPP service-offering positioning, and equip local market teams with playbooks and enablement to engage opportunities consistently.

Position Qualifications and Experience Requirements:

• Senior Professional with solid experience in setting up and managing Commercial Operations.

• Strong Project Management acumen with proven experience in leading, managing and delivering projects.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Riepilogo del ruolo
Costruire ed eseguire il motore operativo del PPP di CSL ( Public-Private Partnerships ) Centro di Eccellenza — la governance, metodologie, dati, sistemi e rete interna che consentono a CSL di valutare, decidere, ed eseguire opportunità di partnership governative a velocità e come organizzazione magra. Partner del Direttore, PPP Engagements (Business Development), che guida l'impegno e l'origine del governo esterno, possiede le capacità interne, i processi e le infrastrutture che rendono tali impegni rigorosi, ripetibili e ben governati.

A. Metodologia, Strumenti e Quadri decisionali

• Migliorare e migliorare continuamente il toolkit per valutare le opportunità di partenariato governativo — modelli standardizzati di casi aziendali, criteri decisionali - garantendo analisi comparabili su mercati e opzioni di servizio. Liaise con FBP per garantire che i modelli eNPV, P&L e LRP siano sincronizzati con le ultime ipotesi e informazioni.

• Mantenere la metodologia PPP Stage Gate, i criteri di qualificazione e la governance di approvazione, compresi i diritti di decisione a ogni cancello.

• Identificare e costruire nuovi strumenti e funzionalità che aumentano l'efficienza, la resilienza e la sostenibilità del CoE.

B. Governance & Decision Forums

• Eseguire il ritmo operativo della governance PPP: preparare e orchestrare la Taskforce PPP e altri comitati (agendas, pre-reads, mazzi riutilizzabili, decisioni e monitoraggio delle azioni).

• Allineare il calendario PPP e gli input con i cicli aziendali — Piano Strategico, LRP, Market Demand & Capacity Planning — in modo che gli impegni PPP fluiscano nelle previsioni aziendali e nella pianificazione dell'offerta, in coordinamento con le Operazioni.

• Proporre l'evoluzione della governance o del formato per il collegamento con gli stakeholder interni (Taskforce, leadership, allineamento interfunzionale).

• Identificare attivamente le esigenze per l'impegno e l'organizzazione di sostegno degli stakeholder di questi impegni.

C. Pipeline & Portfolio Management

• Mantenere un oleodotto di opportunità dinamico e qualificato in stretta collaborazione con il Direttore, PPP Engagements, consentendo un approccio proattivo e mirato alla crescita.

• Definire e operare il passaggio dall'opportunità all'esecuzione — piano operativo, risonante, linee temporali, pietre miliari critici, KPI — con il piombo e le operazioni e rappresentanti del mercato locale.

D. Dati, Sistemi e Reporting

• Assicurare che i dati PPP vengano acquisiti e mantenuti nei sistemi aziendali (GTMS, Rapid Response, I360) e nei database fit-for-purpose in cui non esiste alcun sistema.

• Progettare ed eseguire cruscotti insieme a partner I&A per il monitoraggio delle metriche PPP, la salute delle tubazioni e le prestazioni esistenti di PPP per la leadership e la Taskforce PPP.

E. Conoscenza e intelligenza

• Costruire e curare un unico repository interno per documenti PPP, modelli, casi di business e approfondimenti per abilitazione di concetto "One Source of Truth".

• Collabora a stretto contatto con il team di Intelligenza Competitiva per mantenere l'intelligenza competitiva e di mercato (strutture di concorrenza, prezzi, tempi) e alimentarla in decisioni e metodologie.

• Eseguire un ciclo di apprendimento delle lezioni sulle opportunità vinte/perdute per affinare il quadro.

F. Rete interna, Abilitazione & Avocacy

• Mappa degli stakeholder interni ed esterni (roles, RACI, piani di impegno) ed eventi (ad esempio, congressi) che supportano lo sviluppo commerciale PPP. Stabilire un piano annuale per gli impegni esterni per il team PPP CoE in stretta collaborazione con il Direttore, PPP Engagements.

• Coltivare la rete interfunzionale — Commerciale, Strategia, Finanza, Legale/E&C, PAGA, Operazioni, Plasma/Supply Chain ecc.

• Costruire la consapevolezza interna del posizionamento del service-offering di CSL, e dotare le squadre di mercato locali con i playbook e la possibilità di coinvolgere costantemente le opportunità.

Qualifiche di posizione e requisiti di esperienza:

• Senior Professional con solida esperienza nella creazione e gestione delle operazioni commerciali.

• Forte acume Project Management con comprovata esperienza nel guidare, gestire e realizzare progetti.

• Forte in

descriptionByLocale.de:
Rollenzusammenfassung
Aufbau und Betrieb des Betriebsmotors des CSL PPP (Public-Private Partnerships) Center of Excellence - die Governance, Methoden, Daten, Systeme und internes Netzwerk, die es CSL ermöglichen, staatliche Partnerschaftsmöglichkeiten schnell und als schlanke Organisation zu bewerten, zu entscheiden und auszuführen. Partnerschaft mit dem Direktor, PPP Engagements (Business Development), der externes Regierungsengagement und Deal Origination leitet, indem er die internen Fähigkeiten, Prozesse und Infrastruktur besitzt, die diese Engagements rigoros, wiederholbar und gut regiert machen.

A. Methodik, Werkzeuge und Entscheidungsrahmen

• Eigenes und kontinuierliches Verbessern des Toolkits zur Bewertung von Möglichkeiten für staatliche Partnerschaften – standardisierte Business Case Vorlagen, Entscheidungskriterien – um eine vergleichbare Analyse über Märkte und Serviceoptionen hinweg zu gewährleisten. Verbindung mit FBP, um sicherzustellen, dass eNPV-, P&L- und LRP-Modelle mit den neuesten Annahmen und Informationen synchronisiert werden.

• Pflegen Sie die PPP Stage Gate-Methodik, Qualifizierungskriterien und Genehmigungs-Governance, einschließlich der Entscheidungsrechte an jedem Gate.

• Identifizieren und erstellen Sie neue Tools und Fähigkeiten, die die Effizienz, Widerstandsfähigkeit und Nachhaltigkeit des CoE erhöhen.

B. Governance- und Entscheidungsforen

• Führen Sie den Arbeitsrhythmus der PPP-Governance durch: Bereiten Sie die PPP Taskforce und andere Ausschüsse vor und orchestrieren Sie sie (Agenden, Pre-Reads, wiederverwendbare Decks, Entscheidungen und Aktionsverfolgung).

• Richten Sie den PPP-Kalender und die Inputs an die Unternehmenszyklen aus - Strategischer Plan, LRP, Marktnachfrage- und Kapazitätsplanung -, damit die PPP-Verpflichtungen in Abstimmung mit Operations in die Unternehmensprognosen und die Angebotsplanung fließen.

• Vorschlag für eine Weiterentwicklung der Governance oder des Formats für die Verbindung mit internen Stakeholdern (Taskforce, Führung, funktionsübergreifende Ausrichtung).

• Erkennen Sie proaktiv den Bedarf an Stakeholder-Engagement und unterstützen Sie die Organisation dieser Engagements.

C. Pipeline- und Portfoliomanagement

• Pflegen Sie eine dynamische, qualifizierte Gelegenheitspipeline in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Direktor, PPP Engagements, die einen proaktiven, fokussierten Wachstumsansatz ermöglicht.

• Definieren und operationalisieren Sie die Übergabe von der Gelegenheit zur Ausführung - Operationsplan, Resourcing, Zeitpläne, kritische Meilensteine, KPIs - mit dem Engagements Lead and Operations und lokalen Marktvertretern.

D. Daten, Systeme und Berichterstattung

• Stellen Sie sicher, dass PPP-Daten in Unternehmenssystemen (GTMS, Rapid Response, I360) und in geeigneten Datenbanken, in denen kein System vorhanden ist, erfasst und gepflegt werden.

• Design und Betrieb von Dashboards zusammen mit I & A-Partnern für die Verfolgung von PPP-Metriken, Pipeline-Gesundheit und bestehende PPP-Deals Leistung für die Führung und die PPP Taskforce.

E. Wissen und Intelligenz

• Erstellen und kuratieren Sie ein einziges internes Repository für PPP-Dokumente, Vorlagen, Business Cases und Insights für das Konzept "One Source of Truth".

• Arbeiten Sie eng mit dem Competitive Intelligence-Team zusammen, um Wettbewerbs- und Marktinformationen (Wettbewerber-Deal-Strukturen, Preisgestaltung, Timing) zu erhalten und in Entscheidungen und Methodik einzufließen.

• Führen Sie eine Lessons-Learning-Schleife zu gewonnenen / verlorenen Gelegenheiten durch, um den Rahmen zu schärfen.

F. Internes Netzwerk, Enablement & Advocacy

• Karte interne und externe Stakeholder (Rollen, RACI, Engagement-Pläne) und Veranstaltungen (z. B. Kongresse), die die kommerzielle Entwicklung von PPP unterstützen. Erstellung eines jährlichen Plans für externe Engagements für das PPP CoE-Team in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Direktor, PPP Engagements.

• Pflegen Sie das funktionsübergreifende Netzwerk - Commercial, Strategy, Finance, Legal / E & C, PAGA, Operations, Plasma / Supply Chain usw.

• Aufbau eines internen Bewusstseins für die Positionierung der PPP-Services von CSL und Ausstattung lokaler Marktteams mit Playbooks und Enablement, um Chancen konsequent zu nutzen.

Positionsqualifikationen und Erfahrungsanforderungen:

• Senior Professional mit solider Erfahrung in der Einrichtung und Verwaltung von Commercial Operations.

• Starkes Projektmanagement mit nachgewiesener Erfahrung in der Leitung, Verwaltung und Durchführung von Projekten.

• Stark in
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Résumé des rôles
Bâtir et exploiter le moteur d'exploitation du centre d'excellence PPP de CSL (Public-Private Partnerships ) – la gouvernance, les méthodologies, les données, les systèmes et le réseau interne qui permettent à CSL d'évaluer, de décider et d'exécuter les opportunités de partenariat gouvernemental à la vitesse et en tant qu'organisation maigre. Partenariat avec le directeur, Engagement en matière de PPP (Développement des entreprises), qui dirige l'engagement externe du gouvernement et l'origine des transactions, en possédant les capacités, les processus et l'infrastructure internes qui rendent ces engagements rigoureux, répétables et bien gérés.

A. Méthodologie, outils et cadres de décision

• Améliorer en permanence la trousse d'évaluation des possibilités de partenariat du gouvernement - modèles d'analyse de rentabilisation normalisés, critères décisionnels - en assurant une analyse comparable entre les marchés et les options de service. Assurer la liaison avec FBP pour s'assurer que les modèles eNPV, P&L et LRP sont synchronisés avec les dernières hypothèses et informations.

• Maintenir la méthodologie de l'étape PPP, les critères de qualification et la gouvernance de l'approbation, y compris les droits de décision à chaque étape.

• Identifier et développer de nouveaux outils et capacités qui augmentent l'efficacité, la résilience et la durabilité du Conseil de l'Europe.

B. Forums sur la gouvernance et les décisions

• Diriger le rythme opérationnel de la gouvernance PPP : préparer et orchestrer le groupe de travail PPP et d'autres comités (agendas, pré-lectures, jeux réutilisables, décisions et suivi d'action).

• Alignez le calendrier des PPP et les intrants sur les cycles d'entreprise — Plan stratégique, PRL, Demande du marché et planification des capacités — de sorte que les engagements en matière de PPP se répercutent sur les prévisions des entreprises et la planification de l'offre, en coordination avec les Opérations.

• Proposer l'évolution de la gouvernance ou du format de connexion avec les intervenants internes (taskforce, leadership, alignement interfonctionnel).

• Déterminer de façon proactive les besoins d'engagement des intervenants et appuyer l'organisation de ces engagements.

C. Gestion des pipelines et du portefeuille

• Maintenir un portefeuille d'opportunités dynamiques et qualifiées en étroite collaboration avec le directeur, Engagement en matière de PPP, permettant une approche proactive et ciblée de la croissance.

• Définir et rendre opérationnel le transfert de l'occasion à l'exécution — plan opérationnel, ressourcement, échéanciers, jalons critiques, ICR — avec le responsable des engagements et des opérations et les représentants du marché local.

D. Données, systèmes et rapports

• Veiller à ce que les données relatives aux PPP soient saisies et conservées dans les systèmes d'entreprise (GTMS, Rapid Response, I360) et dans les bases de données adaptées aux besoins lorsqu'il n'existe pas de système.

• Concevoir et exécuter des tableaux de bord en collaboration avec des partenaires d'E et A pour suivre les paramètres des PPP, la santé des pipelines et les PPP existants traite des résultats pour le leadership et le Groupe de travail sur les PPP.

E. Connaissances et renseignements

• Créer et gérer un dépôt interne unique pour les documents PPP, les modèles, les analyses de rentabilisation et les idées pour l'activation du concept « Une source de vérité ».

• Collaborer étroitement avec l'équipe du renseignement concurrentiel pour maintenir le renseignement concurrentiel et commercial (structures des marchés des concurrents, prix, calendrier) et l'alimenter dans les décisions et la méthodologie.

• Lancer une boucle de leçons apprises sur les possibilités gagnées/perdues pour affiner le cadre.

F. Réseau interne, habilitation et plaidoyer

• Planifier les intervenants internes et externes (rôles, RACI, plans d'engagement) et les événements (par exemple, congrès) qui appuient le développement commercial des PPP. Établir un plan annuel d'engagements externes pour l'équipe du Comité des partenariats public-privé en étroite collaboration avec le directeur, Engagements en matière de partenariats public-privé.

• Cultiver le réseau interfonctionnel — Commercial, Stratégie, Finances, Legal/E&C, PAGA, Opérations, Plasma/chaîne d'approvisionnement, etc.

• Accroître la sensibilisation interne au positionnement de l'offre de services PPP de CSL et doter les équipes locales du marché de livres de jeu et de moyens permettant d'engager les occasions de façon cohérente.

Qualifications du poste et exigences en matière d'expérience :

• Professionnel supérieur ayant une solide expérience dans la mise en place et la gestion des opérations commerciales.

• Forte gestion de projet avec une expérience éprouvée dans la direction, la gestion et la réalisation de projets.

jobs.title: Director of Intellectual Property
jobs.description:
The Director of Intellectual Property provides strategic support to CSL Research and Technical Operations organizations, with a primary responsibility for Tech Ops activities in Bern and Research in Schlieren (Zurich). In particular, the role will support CSL plasma and recombinant platforms within Technical Operations and Translational Research activities.

The Director of IP is responsible for identifying, protecting, managing, patent, trade secrets, exclusivities of all types and related intellectual property (IP) matters. Additionally, the Director of IP assesses patentability of inventions, potential infringement of patents and exclusivities, agreements involving patents, know-how, trade secrets and other exclusivity rights, and management of third-party IP risk. The position will work with some independence within the Global IP matrix work model to prepare, prosecute, maintain applications for the global patent portfolio, defend and enforce IP rights and partner with stakeholders and other CSL functions to maximize the value of IP for CSL.

Responsibilities

• Manage and deliver global patent and related intellectual property strategies and support for significant portion of CSL Group’s global activities, especially relevant to CSL Research and Technical Operations. Acts as primary IP contact for Technical Operations in respect of Albumin, Fractionation + Horizon 2 and local nominated Integrated Product Teams (IPTs) such as Ig/Inframarginals, Recombinants and Iron. The role will also serve as the IP advisor to selected European-based Research functions, including Drug Discovery, Translational & Data Science, Non-Clinical Development and associated project teams.

• Manage prosecution and defense of CSL intellectual property by supporting projects from early drug discovery to launch and beyond, including creating and safeguarding of a patent portfolio tailored to CSL’s activities with respect to pending applications and granted patents considering national and international laws and guidelines.

• Contributes to the delivery of enterprise-wide IP strategy for new and existing development-stage products, including optimizing and defending regulatory exclusivities and lifecycle management activities.

• Drive strategic patent filings for key Swiss-owned products (e.g. Privigen, Alburx) to maximise Swiss Patent Box benefits.

• Partner with European-based Research leadership to develop and implement IP strategies supporting pre-clinical programs, platform technologies and translational research activities across key therapeutic areas including Haematology, Cardiovascular & Renal, and Transplant & Immunology, Vaccines and Immunoglobulins.

• Contribute to the identification and preservation of Trade Secrets and, in conjunction with IP team, ensure trade secrets are well protected within the Global IP strategy alongside other IP rights.

• Lead invention harvesting, patent filing and portfolio development activities arising from Research and Technical Operations initiatives, including core technology platforms, manufacturing innovations, analytical methods, formulations, product improvements and next-generation product opportunities.

• Provide freedom to operate analysis across elected countries for assigned portfolio related risks, developing risk mitigation strategies and options and communicating to management and stakeholders.

• Partner with Technical Operations and Research as part of due diligence and deal opportunities.

• Participation in the negotiation of agreements involving patent and related intellectual property matters, such as, confidential disclosures, material transfer, request for proposal (RFP), licensing agreements and other related matters.

• Actively contributes to development of and delivery of education sessions to business partners on aspects of IP across the CSL enterprise.

• Represent CSL Group directly or in cooperation with external attorneys.

• Other complex tasks within the Intellectual

Il Direttore della Proprietà Intellettuale fornisce un supporto strategico alle organizzazioni CSL Research and Technical Operations, con una responsabilità primaria per le attività Tech Ops a Berna e Research in Schlieren (Zurich). In particolare, il ruolo supporterà le piattaforme CSL plasma e ricombinanti all'interno delle attività di Operazioni Tecniche e Ricerca Traduttiva.

Inoltre, il Direttore IP valuta la brevettabilità delle invenzioni, la potenziale violazione dei brevetti e delle esclusioni, gli accordi che coinvolgono brevetti, know-how, segreti commerciali e altri diritti di esclusività, e la gestione del rischio IP di terzi. La posizione lavorerà con una certa indipendenza all'interno del modello di lavoro Global IP matrix per preparare, perseguire, mantenere le applicazioni per il portafoglio brevetti globale, difendere e far rispettare i diritti IP e collaborare con gli stakeholder e altre funzioni CSL per massimizzare il valore di IP per CSL.

responsabilità

descriptionByLocale.en:
The Director of Intellectual Property provides strategic support to CSL Research and Technical Operations organizations, with a primary responsibility for Tech Ops activities in Bern and Research in Schlieren (Zurich). In particular, the role will support CSL plasma and recombinant platforms within Technical Operations and Translational Research activities.

The Director of IP is responsible for identifying, protecting, managing, patent, trade secrets, exclusivities of all types and related intellectual property (IP) matters. Additionally, the Director of IP assesses patentability of inventions, potential infringement of patents and exclusivities, agreements involving patents, know-how, trade secrets and other exclusivity rights, and management of third-party IP risk. The position will work with some independence within the Global IP matrix work model to prepare, prosecute, maintain applications for the global patent portfolio, defend and enforce IP rights and partner with stakeholders and other CSL functions to maximize the value of IP for CSL.

Responsibilities

• Manage and deliver global patent and related intellectual property strategies and support for significant portion of CSL Group’s global activities, especially relevant to CSL Research and Technical Operations. Acts as primary IP contact for Technical Operations in respect of Albumin, Fractionation + Horizon 2 and local nominated Integrated Product Teams (IPTs) such as Ig/Inframarginals, Recombinants and Iron. The role will also serve as the IP advisor to selected European-based Research functions, including Drug Discovery, Translational & Data Science, Non-Clinical Development and associated project teams.

• Manage prosecution and defense of CSL intellectual property by supporting projects from early drug discovery to launch and beyond, including creating and safeguarding of a patent portfolio tailored to CSL’s activities with respect to pending applications and granted patents considering national and international laws and guidelines.

• Contributes to the delivery of enterprise-wide IP strategy for new and existing development-stage products, including optimizing and defending regulatory exclusivities and lifecycle management activities.

• Drive strategic patent filings for key Swiss-owned products (e.g. Privigen, Alburx) to maximise Swiss Patent Box benefits.

• Partner with European-based Research leadership to develop and implement IP strategies supporting pre-clinical programs, platform technologies and translational research activities across key therapeutic areas including Haematology, Cardiovascular & Renal, and Transplant & Immunology, Vaccines and Immunoglobulins.

• Contribute to the identification and preservation of Trade Secrets and, in conjunction with IP team, ensure trade secrets are well protected within the Global IP strategy alongside other IP rights.

• Lead invention harvesting, patent filing and portfolio development activities arising from Research and Technical Operations initiatives, including core technology platforms, manufacturing innovations, analytical methods, formulations, product improvements and next-generation product opportunities.

• Provide freedom to operate analysis across elected countries for assigned portfolio related risks, developing risk mitigation strategies and options and communicating to management and stakeholders.

• Partner with Technical Operations and Research as part of due diligence and deal opportunities.

• Participation in the negotiation of agreements involving patent and related intellectual property matters, such as, confidential disclosures, material transfer, request for proposal (RFP), licensing agreements and other related matters.

• Actively contributes to development of and delivery of education sessions to business partners on aspects of IP across the CSL enterprise.

• Represent CSL Group directly or in cooperation with external attorneys.

• Other complex tasks within the Intellectual
descriptionByLocale.de:
Der Direktor für geistiges Eigentum leistet strategische Unterstützung für CSL-Forschungs- und technische Operations-Organisationen, mit der Hauptverantwortung für Tech Ops-Aktivitäten in Bern und Forschung in Schlieren (Zürich). Insbesondere wird die Rolle CSL-Plasma und rekombinante Plattformen im Rahmen von Technical Operations und Translational Research unterstützen.

Der Direktor des geistigen Eigentums ist für die Identifizierung, den Schutz, die Verwaltung, das Patent, Geschäftsgeheimnisse, Ausschließlichkeiten aller Art und damit verbundene Angelegenheiten des geistigen Eigentums (IP) verantwortlich. Darüber hinaus bewertet der IP-Direktor die Patentierbarkeit von Erfindungen, mögliche Verletzung von Patenten und Exklusivitäten, Patentvereinbarungen, Know-how, Geschäftsgeheimnisse und andere Exklusivitätsrechte sowie das Management von IP-Risiken Dritter. Die Position wird mit einer gewissen Unabhängigkeit innerhalb des globalen IP-Matrix-Arbeitsmodells zusammenarbeiten, um Anwendungen für das globale Patentportfolio vorzubereiten, zu verfolgen, zu pflegen, IP-Rechte zu verteidigen und durchzusetzen und mit Stakeholdern und anderen CSL-Funktionen zusammenzuarbeiten, um den Wert von IP für CSL zu maximieren.

Zuständigkeiten

• Verwalten und liefern Sie globale Patent- und verwandte Strategien für geistiges Eigentum und unterstützen Sie einen erheblichen Teil der globalen Aktivitäten der CSL Group, insbesondere für CSL Research and Technical Operations. Funktioniert als primärer IP-Kontakt für technische Operationen in Bezug auf Albumin, Fractionation + Horizon 2 und lokale nominierte Integrated Product Teams (IPTs) wie Ig / Inframarginals, Rekombinanten und Eisen. descriptionByLocale.fr:
Le directeur de la propriété intellectuelle fournit un appui stratégique aux organismes de recherche et d'exploitation technique du CSL, dont la responsabilité première est d'effectuer les activités d'opérations techniques à Berne et de recherche à Schlieren (Zurich). En particulier, le rôle appuiera le plasma CSL et les plateformes recombinantes dans le cadre des activités d'exploitation technique et de recherche translationnelle.

Le directeur de la propriété intellectuelle est responsable de l'identification, de la protection, de la gestion, des brevets, des secrets commerciaux, des exclusions de tous types et des questions de propriété intellectuelle connexes. En outre, le directeur de la propriété intellectuelle évalue la brevetabilité des inventions, les atteintes potentielles aux brevets et aux exclusivités, les accords concernant les brevets, le savoir-faire, les secrets commerciaux et autres droits d'exclusivité, et la gestion du risque de propriété intellectuelle pour les tiers. Le poste travaillera avec une certaine indépendance dans le cadre du modèle de travail de la matrice mondiale de la propriété intellectuelle pour préparer, poursuivre, maintenir les demandes pour le portefeuille mondial de brevets, défendre et faire respecter les droits de propriété intellectuelle et s'associer avec les parties prenantes et d'autres fonctions CSL afin de maximiser la valeur de la propriété intellectuelle pour CSL.

Responsabilités

• Gérer et mettre en oeuvre des stratégies mondiales en matière de brevets et de propriété intellectuelle et soutenir une partie importante des activités mondiales du Groupe CSL, en particulier celles qui concernent la recherche et les opérations techniques. Agit comme premier contact IP pour les opérations techniques en ce qui concerne l'albumine, Fractionation + Horizon 2 et les équipes de produits intégrées (IPT) désignées localement, comme Ig/Inframarginales, Recombinants et Fer. Ce rôle sera également le conseiller en propriété intellectuelle pour certaines fonctions de recherche européennes, notamment la découverte de médicaments, la traduction et la science des données, le développement non clinique et les équipes de projet associées.

• Gérer les poursuites et la défense de la propriété intellectuelle CSL en appuyant des projets allant de la découverte précoce de drogues au lancement et au-delà, y compris la création et la sauvegarde d'un portefeuille de brevets adapté aux activités de CSL.

• Contribuer à la mise en oeuvre d'une stratégie globale de propriété intellectuelle pour les produits nouveaux et existants, y compris l'optimisation et la défense des exclusivités réglementaires et des activités de gestion du cycle de vie.

• Produire des dépôts stratégiques de brevets pour des produits clés appartenant à la Suisse (p. ex. Privigen, Alburx) afin de maximiser les avantages de la Boîte aux brevets suisse.

• S'associer à la direction de la recherche européenne pour élaborer et mettre en oeuvre des stratégies de propriété intellectuelle soutenant les programmes précliniques, les technologies de plate-forme et les activités de recherche translationnelle dans des domaines thérapeutiques clés tels que l'hématologie, la cardio-vasculaire et le renal, la transplantation et l'immunologie, les vaccins et les immunoglobulines.

• Contribuer à l'identification et à la préservation des secrets commerciaux et, en collaboration avec l'équipe de la propriété intellectuelle, veiller à ce que les secrets commerciaux soient bien protégés dans le cadre de la stratégie mondiale de propriété intellectuelle aux côtés d'autres droits de propriété intellectuelle.

• Principales activités de récolte d'inventions, de dépôt de brevets et d'élaboration de portefeuilles découlant d'initiatives de recherche et d'exploitation technique, y compris les plates-formes technologiques de base, les innovations de fabrication, les méthodes d'analyse, les formulations, l'amélioration des produits et les débouchés de la prochaine génération.

• Fournir la liberté d'effectuer des analyses dans les pays élus pour les risques liés au portefeuille assignés, élaborer des stratégies et des options d'atténuation des risques et communiquer avec la direction et les parties prenantes.

• S'associer aux opérations et à la recherche techniques dans le cadre de la diligence raisonnable et saisir les occasions.

• Participation à la négociation d'accords portant sur des questions de brevets et de propriété intellectuelle connexes, telles que les divulgations confidentielles, le transfert de matériel, la demande de proposition, les accords de licence et autres questions connexes.

• Contribuer activement au développement et à la prestation de séances d'éducation aux partenaires commerciaux sur les aspects de la propriété intellectuelle dans l'ensemble de l'entreprise CSL.

• Représenter CSL Grouper directement ou en coopération avec des avocats extérieurs.

• Autres tâches complexes au sein de l'intellectuel

jobs.description:
Scientist (m/f/x) – Cell Biology and Gene Editing
Temporary position, 1 year | Schlieren, Switzerland

We are looking for a hands-on Scientist to join our Mechanistic Pharmacology team within Translational Research in Schlieren. This temporary one-year position will focus on developing and applying human in vitro models, functional assays, and gene editing approaches to support cardiovascular and renal research programs.

About the Role

• Develop and apply human in vitro models and functional assay workflows to support translational research programs.

• Generate high-quality experimental data to characterize the mode of action of novel therapeutic candidates in cardiovascular and renal indications.

• Independently perform human cell culture, transfection, gene editing, and assay workflows with strong attention to scientific rigor, reproducibility, and data quality.

• Contribute to the design, optimization, and continuous improvement of experimental approaches and assay performance.

• Analyze, interpret, and clearly present experimental results to project teams and stakeholders.

• Maintain accurate documentation of experimental work and support implementation of laboratory best practices and quality standards.

• Ensure compliance with laboratory safety procedures and contribute to a safe, well-organized, and collaborative working environment.

• Work closely with scientists across projects and functions, contributing to a highly interactive and team-oriented research setting.

Your Profile

• Master’s degree in Cell Biology, Life Sciences, or a related scientific discipline, or equivalent relevant laboratory experience; industry experience is an advantage.

• At least 3 years of practical laboratory experience in cell biology, including strong expertise in human cell culture, such as HUVECs, and transfection methods.

• Hands-on experience with CRISPR-based gene editing approaches.

• Proficiency in molecular biology techniques, including RT-qPCR, immunoassays and Western blotting.

• Experience with imaging-based techniques is an advantage.

• Experience in troubleshooting experiments, handling laboratory equipment, and optimizing workflows to improve assay robustness and performance.

• Ability to work independently and take ownership of experiments from study design through execution, analysis, and presentation of results.

• Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and commitment to high-quality experimental documentation.

• Proficiency in written and spoken English.

• Collaborative mindset, flexibility, and ability to work effectively across teams and with different project stakeholders.

About CSL Behring
CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives.

CSL Behring operates one of the world’s largest plasma collection networks, CSL Plasma. Our parent company, CSL, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs 32,000 people, and delivers its lifesaving therapies to people in more than 100 countries.

Posizione provvisoria, 1 anno | Schlieren, Svizzera

Stiamo cercando uno scienziato pratico per unire il nostro team di Farmacologia Meccanica all'interno della Ricerca Traduttiva a Schlieren. Questa posizione temporanea di un anno si concentrerà sullo sviluppo e l'applicazione di modelli in vitro umano, saggi funzionali e approcci di editing genico per supportare i programmi di ricerca cardiovascolare e renale.

Informazioni sul ruolo

• Sviluppare e applicare modelli in vitro umani e flussi di lavoro di saggi funzionali per supportare programmi di ricerca traduttiva.

• Generare dati sperimentali di alta qualità per caratterizzare il modo di azione di nuovi candidati terapeutici in indicazioni cardiovascolari e renali.

• Indipendentemente eseguire la cultura delle cellule umane, la trasfezione, la modifica dei geni e i flussi di lavoro di analisi con forte attenzione al rigore scientifico, la riproducibilità e la qualità dei dati.

• Contribuisci alla progettazione, ottimizzazione e miglioramento continuo degli approcci sperimentali e delle prestazioni del test.

• Analizzare, interpretare e presentare chiaramente risultati sperimentali a team di progetto e stakeholder.

• Mantenere la documentazione accurata del lavoro sperimentale e sostenere l'attuazione delle migliori pratiche di laboratorio e standard di qualità.

• Assicurare il rispetto delle procedure di sicurezza di laboratorio e contribuire a un ambiente di lavoro sicuro, ben organizzato e collaborativo.

• Lavorare a stretto contatto con gli scienziati attraverso progetti e funzioni, contribuendo a un ambiente di ricerca altamente interattivo e orientato al team.

Il tuo profilo

• Laurea magistrale in biologia cellulare, scienze della vita, o una disciplina scientifica correlata, o equivalente esperienza di laboratorio rilevante; l'esperienza industriale è un vantaggio.

• Almeno 3 anni di esperienza pratica di laboratorio nella biologia cellulare, tra cui una forte esperienza nella cultura delle cellule umane, come gli HUVEC e i metodi di trasfezione.

• Esperienza pratica con approcci di editing gene basati su CRISPR.

• Proficienza nelle tecniche di biologia molecolare, tra cui RT-qPCR, immunoassays e Western blotting.

• L'esperienza con le tecniche basate sull'imaging è un vantaggio.

• Esperienza nella risoluzione dei problemi esperimenti, nella gestione di apparecchiature di laboratorio e nell'ottimizzazione dei flussi di lavoro per migliorare la robustezza e le prestazioni del test.

• Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e prendere la proprietà di esperimenti dal design dello studio attraverso l'esecuzione, l'analisi e la presentazione dei risultati.

• Forte capacità organizzative, attenzione ai dettagli e impegno nella documentazione sperimentale di alta qualità.

• Competenza in inglese scritto e parlato.

• Mindset collaborativo, flessibilità e capacità di lavorare efficacemente in team e con diversi stakeholder di progetto.

Informazioni su CSL Behring
CSL Behring è un leader globale di biotherapeutics guidato dalla nostra promessa di salvare vite. Concentrati sulle esigenze dei pazienti utilizzando le più recenti tecnologie, scopriamo, sviluppiamo e forniamo terapie innovative per le persone che vivono con condizioni di immunologia, ematologia, cardiovascolare e metabolica, respiratoria e trapianto aree terapeutiche. Utilizziamo tre piattaforme scientifiche strategiche di frazionamento del plasma, tecnologia delle proteine ricombinanti, e terapia cellulare e genica per supportare l'innovazione continua e perfezionare continuamente i modi in cui i prodotti possono affrontare bisogni medici non soddisfatti e aiutare i pazienti a condurre una vita piena.

CSL Behring gestisce una delle più grandi reti di raccolta al plasma del mondo, CSL Plasma. La nostra società madre, CSL, con sede a Melbourne, Australia, impiega 32.000 persone, e fornisce le sue terapie salvavita per le persone in più di 100 paesi.

jobs.description:
For our global Technical Operations Organization, we are currently looking for a

Lab Automation Specialist - Analytics (m/f/x)
Locations available: Bern

The Opportunity
The Lab Automation Specialist is responsible for automating laboratory systems and workflows ensuring seamless integration of automation technologies to enhance lab efficiency, accuracy and throughout.

Key Responsibilities:

• Support the development, implementation and management of lab automation systems, including liquid handlers, robotic arms and LIMS​

• Collaborate with TES AI/automation group, scientist, engineers and IT teams to identify and implement automation opportunities to streamline laboratory process​

• Design and optimise automated workflows for sample preparation, analysis, and data management.​

• Maintain, troubleshoot, and optimise automation equipment and software to ensure reliability and operational continuity​

• Ensure integration of automation systems with existing lab information management (LIMS), electronic Lab Notebooks (ELNs) and data integration​

• Train lab personnel on the proper use of automated systems and ensure compliance with SOP and safety standards​

• Together with TES automation lead manage end-to-end automation projects, including planning, validation, deployment, and post-implementation support.

Your skills and experience

• Bachelor or Master degree in life sciences, engineering or computer science ​

• 3+ years in lab automation ​

• Hands on experience with lab automation platforms such as Tecan, Hamilton, or Beckman Coulter ​

• Strong programming/scripting skills in languages such as Python​

• Familiarity with ELN, LIMs and data integration tools for Lab data management​

• Familiarity with GLP/GMP and regulated laboratory environments​

• Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills

About CSL Behring
CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives.

CSL Behring operates one of the world’s largest plasma collection networks, CSL Plasma. Our parent company, CSL, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs 32,000 people, and delivers its lifesaving therapies to people in more than 100 countries.
To learn more about CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus and CSL Vifor visit https://www.csl.com/ and CSL Plasma at https://www.cslplasma.com/ .

Our Benefits
For more information on CSL benefits visit How CSL Supports Your Well-being | CSL .

You Belong at CSL
At CSL, Inclusion and Belonging is at the core of our mission and who we are. It fuels our innovation day in and day out. By celebrating our differences and creating a culture of curiosity and empathy, we are able to better understand and connect with our patients and donors, foster strong relationships with our stakeholders, and sustain a diverse workforce that will move our company and industry into the future.
To learn more about inclusion and belonging visit https://www.csl.com/careers/inclusion-and-belonging
